jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

The Project Coordinator supports the Project Management team by coordinating vendor setup, customer account setup, retail item onboarding, product data management, and the administrative activities required to bring physical consumer products to market.

This role requires prior experience working in the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry with physical consumer products sold through retail channels. The ideal candidate has experience supporting products in categories such as beauty, personal care, oral care, wellness, accessories, fashion, or other retail CPG categories.

The Project Coordinator works cross\-functionally with Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Sales, Packaging/Creative, and Shipping/Logistics to ensure product information, documentation, samples, item setup, and customer requirements are completed accurately and on time.

This position serves as the department's Vendor \& Item Setup Specialist, while also providing day\-to\-day operational and project coordination support to the Project Management team.

**Responsibilities Product \& Retailer Setup**

* Set up and maintain customer and vendor accounts across retailer, distributor, and customer portals.
* Coordinate new product and item setup requirements for retail customers, distributors, and internal systems.
* Coordinate product information requirements including UPCs, dimensions, case packs, product descriptions, pricing, specifications, packaging information, and other required data.
* Maintain accurate product and item information throughout product launches and ongoing product changes.
* Monitor customer\-specific requirements and ensure submissions are completed accurately and within required timelines

**Cross\-Functional Product Coordination**

* Work cross\-functionally with Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Sales, Packaging/Creative, Operations, and Shipping/Logistics to collect and coordinate information required for product launches.
* Follow up with internal departments to obtain product specifications, regulatory information, packaging details, pricing, UPCs, quality documentation, shipping requirements, and other required launch information.
* Coordinate the flow of information between Project Management and internal departments to keep product launches and customer requirements moving forward.
* Support Project Managers with product launch activities, running changes, customer requests, and other project\-related tasks.

**Samples, Shipping \& Logistics**

* Order and coordinate product samples.
* Prepare, package, and ship samples and documents using FedEx and other carriers.
* Maintain accurate records of sample requests, shipments, and related documentation.

**Required Qualifications**

* Previous professional experience in the Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG) industry is required.
* Experience working with physical consumer products that are manufactured and sold through retail channels is required.
* Experience working cross\-functionally with multiple departments is required.
* Experience with product/item setup, retail customer requirements, customer portals, vendor onboarding, or product data management is strongly preferred.
* High school diploma or equivalent required; Bachelor's degree preferred. Equivalent relevant industry experience may be considered in lieu of a degree.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines.
* Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy.
* Experience with project management tools such as Jira, Monday.com, Asana, or similar platforms is preferred.

**Physical \& Position Requirements**

* Full\-time hourly position, onsite.
* Valid driver's license with reliable personal transportation to deliver packages and product samples to local shipping carriers as needed.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 25 pounds.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment while managing multiple deadlines and changing priorities.

**What We're Looking For**

We're looking for a proactive, organized, dependable CPG professional who understands how physical consumer products move through a retail environment and enjoys keeping the details behind those products organized and moving forward.

The right person is comfortable working across departments, following up for information, managing deadlines, navigating customer requirements, and jumping between different priorities without losing track of details.

This is not simply an administrative role. We need someone who understands the product lifecycle and retail environment, can communicate effectively with Product Development, Supply Chain, Quality, Regulatory, Sales, and Logistics, and takes ownership of getting things done.

The ideal candidate is a self\-starter who sees what needs to be done, follows through, and anticipates issues. No task is too small or too large; the expectation is that this person will jump in where needed and help keep the Project Management team and product launches moving.

Pay: $28\.85 \- $31\.25 per hour

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* Do you have experience working with physical consumer products sold through retail channels?
* Do you have professional experience working with physical consumer packaged goods (CPG) products sold through retail channels?
* Which consumer product categories have you worked in? Beauty / Personal Care

Oral Care, Health / Wellness, Accessories, Fashion / Apparel, Other Consumer Packaged Goods (CPG)

* Which functions have you worked cross\-functionally with when coordinating physical consumer products?
* Do you have experience with product or item setup for retailers/customers, including managing product information, specifications, documentation, or customer\-specific requirements?

Experience:

* CPG: 2 years (Required)

Work Location: I

jobs.title: Project Coordinator I
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**



Project Coordinator provides complex administrative support to various members of the project team under the direction of the Office Manager. The Project Coordinator I will be responsible for project oversight and coordination of all its stages from inception to completion by inputting data, tracking, and monitoring control points and program updates. Additional responsibilities include assisting with document management and tracking progress for program estimates.


**Key Responsibilities**


**Project \& Workflow Management**


* Intake new leads and jobs, entering all information across platforms to maintain a single, accurate source of data.
* Under the guidance of the Office manager make decisions regarding project assignment to Project Directors to ensure proper project workflow.
* Schedule initial inspections during the initial phone call to ensure parameters are met and provide a single point of contact.
* Update platforms (XactAnalysis, Symbility, AlacNet) to meet program timelines for customer contact and site inspections.
* Upload work authorizations and insurance\-specific documents promptly to facilitate the release of funds.
* Assist with securing third\-party mortgage authorizations, coordinate mortgage inspections, and manage check endorsements.
* Monitor JobTrack to ensure assignments are compliant and input job\-specific milestones.
* Review daily reports and the TPA/Contractor Connection Dashboard to maintain compliance, resolve discrepancies, and notify billing of any disputes.
* Monitor job progress for USAA checks to ensure timely endorsement at final walk\-throughs and verify check amounts against estimates.

* Attend all appropriate company training and monthly Admin Program meetings.
* Execute administrative support functions and perform special project assistance as needed.


**Qualifications and Experience**


* High School Diploma or equivalent.
* Minimum of 1 year of experience in a coordinator or administrative role.
* Construction industry experience preferred.
* Experience working in Salesforce, including generating reports (preferred).

* **TRAVEL \& WORKING CONDITIONS**
* Travel is minimal for this position.
* This position requires sitting for long periods of time and looking at monitors along with typing for extended periods of time.
* This position may require occasional flexibility in schedule to address urgent or time\-sensitive employee relations matters.
* Work is performed in a professional office environment.


  

Compensation: $25\-27/hr

At JRM Construction, we build more than exceptional spaces \- we build talented teams, rewarding careers, and trusted relationships. As a leading employee\-owned construction firm, our people take ownership of every project and work collaboratively to deliver outstanding quality and a positive client experience. Guided by integrity, teamwork, continuous improvement, and genuine care for our people, JRM provides an environment where employees can grow and help shape the company's long\-term success.

The Assistant Project Manager (APM) is a core team member responsible for managing project change orders, subcontractor coordination, and project documentation with a high level of independence and accountability. jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Social Media Coordinator**

The Social Media Coordinator is responsible for bringing the Los Angeles Ale Works brand to life across social media. This role plans and creates engaging content, manages day\-to\-day publishing and community interaction, and captures the beer, food, events, people, and atmosphere that make each LAAW location distinctive.

The right candidate is creative, organized, comfortable working independently, and energized by being on\-site. This person will work closely with our taprooms, brewery, kitchen, events, and leadership teams to maintain a consistent content calendar and timely social presence. This is a social\-media\-first position; broader marketing projects, may be supported as needed but are not the primary focus of the role. Candidates must share our commitment to quality, craftsmanship, creativity, and authenticity.

The ideal candidate will be knowledgeable about beer, hospitality, Los Angeles culture, social media scheduling platforms, and have experience in project management, writing, photography, and video.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

● Plan and maintain a consistent social media content calendar aligned with beer releases, food specials, events, collaborations, and beer production.

● Create original photography, short\-form video, Stories, Reels, captions, and other platform\-specific content for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and emerging channels.

● Visit Los Angeles Ale Works locations regularly to gain an understanding of the location and capture authentic, timely content featuring products, guests, employees, events, and behind\-the\-scenes activity.

● Schedule and publish content while maintaining a consistent brand voice, visual style, and level of quality across platforms.

● Monitor comments, messages, tags, reviews, and user\-generated content; respond or route issues to the appropriate team in a timely and professional manner.

● Build community engagement by identifying relevant local conversations, partners, creators, organizations, and cross\-promotional opportunities.

● Coordinate with internal teams to gather accurate information, assets, dates, and priorities for upcoming posts and event coverage.

● Create simple digital graphics and promotional assets for social media using Canva or Adobe.

● Track platform performance and provide clear, practical reporting on reach, engagement, audience growth, and content performance.

● Use performance insights and platform trends to recommend content improvements and test new formats or ideas.

● Maintain an organized library of approved photos, videos, graphics, and reusable content.

● Provide support for related digital and in\-store promotional needs when they directly support social campaigns, beer releases, or events.

● Manage time independently with the ability to toggle between daily and long\-term tasks, keeping workstreams moving forward simultaneously.

● Maintain open lines of communication, patience and professionalism when partnering with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced evolving environment.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

● One to three years of experience managing social media or creating content for a hospitality, food and beverage, lifestyle, entertainment, or consumer brand.

● Strong working knowledge of Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Google Business, and common social scheduling and reporting tools.

● Demonstrated photography, short\-form video, editing, and copywriting skills; a portfolio or examples of past work are preferred.

● Proficiency with Canva; working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, or similar tools.

● Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage a content calendar, multiple locations, and quick\-turn requests.

● Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across departments.

● Sound judgment when representing a brand publicly and responding to guests online.

● Self\-motivated, social, dependable, and comfortable taking initiative while remaining open to feedback.

● A degree in communications, media, marketing, journalism, or a related field is preferred but not required.

● Flexibility in both schedule and duties; willingness to work weekends, evenings, as needed along with traveling between our Hawthorne, Culver City and Hermosa Beach locations

Pay: $30\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

jobs.title: Marketing Coordinator
jobs.description:
SUMMARY  

The Senior Marketing Coordinator develops messages for print and digital forms of marketing, and copyedits content written by self and other members of the Marketing Department team. The incumbent handles daily administrative approval items in customer relationship management (CRM) and timekeeping platforms, and supports marketing campaign/project enhancements and communications for the Marketing department.


ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.  

* Write messages through various content types including print collateral, website content, brochures, publications, product descriptions, press releases, announcements, and other forms of marketing.
* Copyedit content written by self and team members for spelling, grammar, syntax, and punctuation to ensure accuracy and brand consistency. Work closely with designers and marketing team members to update and amend written content according to feedback.
* Conduct research, monitor marketing trends and support competitive marketing campaigns.
* Maintain marketing database and photo library, and filing systems for paper and electronic documents.
* Fulfill administrative tasks such as sample order entry, and maintaining marketing documents and resource materials related marketing and communication activities.
* Handles daily administrative approval items in Salesforce CRM platform (e.g., sample order entry, Co\-op credit, purchase requisitions, check requests, trip reports, IRAs), and timekeeping platform.
* Provide marketing project and tradeshow support.
* Provide customer service and sales support as needed.
* Exercise judgment to balance priorities and communicate to teams to meet and exceed project deadlines and commitments; keep the marketing team informed of projects and progress.
* Assist with special projects and other job\-related duties as assigned.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES  

This position has no supervisory responsibilities.


QUALIFICATIONS  

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed above are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.


EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE  

Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Journalism, Communications, or Public Relations AND 3 years of related experience, OR equivalent combination of education, training and experience.  

Prior experience in corporate content creation, Social Media, and other creative content development is a plus.


COMPUTER SKILLS  

Possess intermediate knowledge of MS Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook) and proficiency with PC and Mac platforms and tools. Basic knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Photoshop, and Illustrator) is a plus.


LANGUAGE SKILLS  

Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write routine reports and correspondence. Ability to speak effectively before groups of customers or employees of the organization. The ability to present ideas effectively using both oral and written skills. Ability to communicate effectively with customers, vendors, and co\-workers.  

Ability to write clearly and with good logic, and ensure content has correct punctuation, grammar, and syntax.


REASONING ABILITY  

Ability to solve practical problems and deal with a variety of concrete variables in situations where only limited standardization exists. Abilities to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, verbal, diagram, or schedule form.


PHYSICAL DEMANDS  

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  

While performing duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to use hands to handle, or feel, and talk or hear. The employee is frequently required to sit. The employee is occasionally required to lift and/or move up to 25 pounds and rarely lift and/or move up to 50 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, and ability to adjust focus.


WORK ENVIRONMENT  

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.  

The noise level in the work environment is usually quiet.

jobs.title: Facilities & Lab Operations Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Provivi Overview:**



Provivi™ is a California\-based, globally operating AgTech company using pheromones to protect crops from major damaging insects. Our patented production method enables a step change in the cost of manufacturing pheromones, allowing us to pioneer the use of this proven tool in high\-acreage crops such as corn, rice and soy.

  



Founded in 2013 by Nobel laureate Frances Arnold and Caltech scholars Pedro Coelho and Peter Meinhold, we are hiring the very best and brightest people to develop and commercialize our products.

  


**Role Description:**



We are seeking a hands\-on, highly organized, part\-time Facilities \& Lab Operations Coordinator to support the day\-to\-day operation of our Santa Monica facility.

  

This is an onsite role responsible for making sure the workplace and laboratory environment remains safe, organized, supplied, and operational. The Facilities Manager will serve as the primary point person for routine facility needs, vendors, shipping and receiving, supplies, safety checks, and general site coordination.



This role is a good fit for someone who enjoys owning the details behind a well\-run workplace. You'll work closely with our R\&D team and other business functions, taking ownership of facility operations so scientists and other team members can stay focused on their primary work

  

Because this is a working laboratory environment, the role requires comfort operating around laboratory supplies, chemicals, equipment, and established safety procedures. Scientific expertise is not required.

 **Specific Responsibilities Include:**



Facility Operations \& Workplace Readiness


* Serve as the primary onsite point of contact for facility needs, maintenance issues, and day\-to\-day site operations.
* Keep common areas, storage, shipping/receiving, and shared workspaces clean, organized, stocked, and operational.
* Coordinate cleaning, maintenance, dry ice delivery, chemical waste pickup, and other recurring facility services.
* Monitor facility and office supplies, maintain appropriate inventory levels, and reorder as needed.
* Conduct regular site walkthroughs with R\&D and site leadership to identify maintenance needs and opportunities for improvement.


Shipping, Receiving \& Inventory


* Receive incoming packages and materials and route them to the appropriate employees or teams.
* Coordinate outbound shipments, including packaging, shipping documentation, EPA\-compliant product labeling, carrier requirements, and applicable regulatory requirements.
* Maintain an organized shipping and receiving area and adequate inventory of shipping supplies.
* Maintain appropriate shipment, packing list, and receiving documentation.
* Partner with Accounting on shipping invoices, approvals, and month\-end inventory needs.


Laboratory \& R\&D Operational Support


* Coordinate routine laboratory supply and vendor needs, including gas tanks, dry ice as needed, and other facility\-supported materials.
* Support chemical and laboratory material receiving, inventory documentation, and storage processes.
* Coordinate chemical and laboratory waste pickup and maintain associated records.
* Monitor equipment maintenance (weight balances, GC machines, deli fridges, etc.) schedules and coordinate service as needed.
* Partner with R\&D on facility needs while leaving scientific and technical decisions with appropriate R\&D team members.


Safety \& Compliance


* Conduct and document routine interior and exterior facility and laboratory safety inspections and escalate concerns promptly.
* Monitor fire extinguishers, medical emergency supply cabinet, eyewash stations, and other facility safety equipment and coordinate required inspections or service.
* Maintain facility safety documentation, including SDS records and applicable vendor and waste documentation. Following up with suppliers in the event an SDS is required on file.
* Coordinate periodic safety walkthroughs with R\&D and other appropriate stakeholders.
* Help ensure facility vendors, storage areas, and routine operations follow established company safety requirements.


Vendor \& Administrative Coordination


* Manage day\-to\-day relationships with cleaning, maintenance, waste, shipping, supply, and other facility vendors.
* Schedule recurring and ad hoc services and follow through to ensure work is completed.
* Review facility\-related invoices and coordinate approvals and documentation with Accounting.
* Receive, sort, and distribute physical mail; scan and digitize documents as appropriate; and electronically route materials to Accounting, HR, Legal, or other teams for review and action.
* Maintain facility records, schedules, and documentation while identifying practical ways to improve reliability, organization, and cost.

  


**Qualifications \& Skills Include:**


* Prior experience in facilities coordination, office/lab operations, workplace operations, or a similar hands\-on operational role.
* Strong organizational skills and comfort managing many small, recurring responsibilities without requiring significant oversight.
* Experience coordinating vendors, supplies, deliveries, shipping, or facility services.
* Ability to identify an issue, determine the appropriate next step, and follow it through to completion.
* Comfortable working onsite in a laboratory/R\&D environment where chemicals and specialized equipment are present.
* Strong attention to safety, documentation, and established procedures.
* Able to perform routine physical aspects of facility operations, including receiving packages, organizing supplies, and moving reasonably sized materials.
* Comfortable working with employees across Supply Chain, R\&D, Accounting, HR, Legal, and other functions.
* Reliable and able to maintain a consistent three\-day\-per\-week onsite schedule.
* Experience supporting a laboratory, biotech, chemical, life\-sciences, or R\&D environment would be particularly helpful, but isn't necess

jobs.title: Transaction Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end\-to\-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.


As a Transaction Coordinator, you will join the Contract to Close team, which oversees all administrative details throughout the contract process, freeing agents to focus on building client relationships and growing their business. Our Transaction team members are experienced in real estate and serve as the first point of contact for all parties involved, ensuring a smooth path to settlement. From document preparation to deadline tracking to requesting online testimonials, your goal is to make life easier for agents and clients every step of the way. You will also work hand in hand with local lenders and title attorneys, bringing extensive experience and strong industry contacts to every contract you process.
  

**Please note: This position will require you to be in the local office 2x per month.**
  

At Compass, You Will:
* Handle document tracking for a large volume of real estate transactions from listing to close, and/or contract to close, ensuring compliance with brokerage and legal requirements — averaging roughly 25\-30 closings per month
* Ensure real estate contracts are processed properly and promptly, with a focus on the details
* Manage and track contract deadlines to ensure all timelines are met
* Navigate company systems to validate the accuracy of compliance and commission records
* Provide support to Agents in response to inquiries regarding commission payouts, deductions, and commission calculations
* Collaborate with sales managers and other support teams to offer outstanding support to the agents

What We're Looking For:
* Real estate license preferred
* Strong knowledge of the real estate laws in California and familiarity with standard real estate forms used in California (SFAR, PRDS, and Local Area Disclosures)
* In\-depth knowledge of Real Estate Transaction Coordination and Compliance
* DocuSign, Google Suite, CTM
* Strong written, quantitative, verbal, and presentation skills
* Ability to digest detailed contracts and make informed decisions based on content
* Ability to maintain strict confidentiality of agents' contracts
* Work independently and collaboratively in a team environment
* Customer service\-oriented personality
* Impeccable attention to detail and problem\-solving skills
* B.A. or B.S. degree preferred

**Compensation:** The base pay range for this position is $31\.25 \- $34\.71/hr; however, base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Bonuses may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location. Minimum wage for the position will always be met.

jobs.description:
**Title:** Marketing Events Coordinator
  
**Department:** Marketing
  
**FSLA Grade:** Hourly (Non\-Exempt), Part\-Time
  
**Salary:** $26\.00 \- $29\.00 per hour
  
  

**Statement of the Job:**  

Assist the Manager of Promotions \& Partnerships in planning, coordinating, and executing promotional marketing events, community activations, and partnership initiatives that support programming at Walt Disney Concert Hall, Hollywood Bowl, The Ford, and off\-site events throughout Greater Los Angeles. As a key representative of the LA Phil, this role builds relationships with community organizations, promotional partners, and audiences while delivering impactful marketing events that expand access to the performing arts and strengthen community engagement across Los Angeles.
  
  

**Estimated Event Volume:**  

This position will support 34 pre\- and post\-concert events and approximately 20 tabling/community activation events. Event volume may vary based on LA Phil’s programming, partnerships, and community engagement opportunities.
  
  

**Essential Functions:**  

* Coordinate and execute marketing events (Drinks in the Garden, Casual Fridays, Chamber Tuesdays, etc.) at Walt Disney Concert Hall and on\-/off\-site activations and partner events for the Hollywood Bowl, The Ford, and community events in Greater LA
* Coordinate with internal teams (The Music Center, Production, Hollywood Bowl Ops, Creative Services, IT, and the Community and Government Engagement) for space availability, crew needs, signage, technology, and event logistics for set ups and breakdowns.
* Coordinate planning meetings with stakeholders on a regular basis to update on production timeline, budget, and troubleshooting if necessary.
* Coordinate and oversee events on the day of, including problem\-solving, welcoming guests, directing event setup, communicating with staff, organizing vendors, and managing takedown.
* Work with supervisor to manage the budget and ensure event stays within guidelines; ensure vendors are paid.
* Coordinate and execute off\-site promotional events and community activations for the Hollywood Bowl and The Ford in collaboration with cultural organizations, community partners, and promotional partners, including Amoeba Music, Smorgasburg, and other local organizations.
* Secure additional staff as needed.
* Transport promotional materials, signage, tents, tables, giveaways, and event equipment to and from activation sites using a personal vehicle.
* Represent the LA Phil professionally while engaging with patrons, community organizations, sponsors, and promotional partners.
* Assist with grassroots marketing initiatives including brochure distribution, community outreach, Corporate Partnerships activations, and neighborhood engagement.
* Create wrap\-up reports for events with detailed notes on improvements and key findings.
* Coordinate with legal, health, and safety obligations with The Music Center or other operations staff.
* Update internal master calendar with events.
* Maintain regular and reliable attendance, including availability for assigned event dates, evenings, and weekends as required by the event schedule.
* Assist with day\-to\-day tasks for the promotions team as needed, including asset management, brochure distribution, and outreach.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Relationships:** Creative Services, Corporate Partnerships, Hope \& Grand Events by Lucques Catering, Music Center Scheduling, Production, Operations, Hollywood Bowl Food \+ Wine.
  
  

**Reports To:** Manager, Promotions \& Partnerships
  
  

**Requirements:**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of two (2\) years of experience coordinating events, marketing activations, or community outreach, preferably in the Greater Los Angeles area.
* Experience in audience development, grassroots marketing, promotions, or partnership marketing is highly preferred.
* Excellent project management, organizational, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting strict deadlines and budgetary constraints.
* Detail\-oriented with demonstrated ability to multitask and bring time\-sensitive projects to completion.
* Capable of working as a member of a team as well as independently.
* Bilingual proficiency, Spanish is strongly preferred, as this role regularly engages with diverse communities and cultural organizations.
* Must possess a valid California driver's license, maintain a reliable personal vehicle, and have automobile insurance. This position requires travel and the ability to transport marketing materials, promotional items, signage, displays, and other event equipment to and from various venues.
* Ability to lift and transport up to 40 pounds and assist with event setup and breakdown.


**Event Schedule and Coverage:**  

* Event dates will be shared in advance. The Coordinator is expected to attend assigned events, including evenings and weekends as needed. If coverage is needed, the Coordinator must notify the Manager at least two (2\) days in advance whenever possible.

The Food \& Beverage Events Coordinator is responsible for planning, coordinating, and flawlessly executing luxury dining and special event experiences throughout the hotel. This role serves as the primary liaison between guests, clients, culinary teams, restaurant operations, and hotel departments, ensuring exceptional service, personalized experiences, and seamless event execution in alignment with Forbes Travel Guide and luxury hospitality standards.


The ideal candidate is highly organized, guest\-focused, detail\-oriented, and passionate about creating memorable experiences for discerning clientele, including VIPs, social events, corporate functions, private dining experiences, and special celebrations.

 **Roles and Responsibilities**

* Manage all event inquiries from initial contact through post\-event follow\-up.
* Coordinate private dining events, afternoon tea experiences, executive meetings, cocktail receptions, buyouts, milestone celebrations, and hotel special events.

* Collaborate closely with Culinary, Pastry, Beverage, Restaurant, IRD, Stewarding,
* Ensure flawless execution of all food and beverage experiences consistent with Forbes and luxury hotel standards.
* Attend pre\-event meetings and operational briefings.
* Monitor events in real time to ensure service flow, presentation standards, and guest satisfaction.
* Address operational challenges quickly while maintaining a calm and professional demeanor.
* Identify opportunities to enhance guest experiences through strategic upselling.
* Promote premium dining experiences, wine packages, specialty menus, private dining opportunities, and exclusive hotel offerings.
* Support departmental revenue goals through effective event planning and relationship\-building.
* Assist in developing customized experiences that increase event spend and guest loyalty.
* Maintain accurate event records, client correspondence, and contracts.
* Manage deposits, payment schedules, billing details, and final invoicing.
* Track event revenue, forecasted business levels, and guest feedback.
* Maintain event calendars and operational schedules.
* Ensure compliance with hotel financial procedures and internal controls.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, Front Office, Housekeeping, Engineering, Security, Spa, and Guest Relations teams.
* Facilitate communication between departments to ensure flawless execution.
* Support hotel\-wide initiatives, promotional events, and luxury guest experiences.
 **QUALIFICATIONS:**

* High school diploma or equivalent; culinary school or relevant certification preferred.
* Previous experience in a restaurant, catering, or food service environment.
* Strong organizational and time management skills.
* Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite and F\&B management software (e.g., POS systems).
* Knowledge of food and beverage trends, industry standards, and best practices.
* Ability to multi\-task
* Strong Interpersonal Skills
* Spanish language skills would be advantageous
* Prior experience in administration preferred
* Self\-motivation, and the ability to work with limited supervision
* Excellent communication skills
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as needed.

 **PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Possible prolonged periods of standing.
* Must be able to lift 15 pounds at times.

 **How you Demonstrate your Talent**


The guests of The Maybourne Beverly Hills are our top priority. We take great pride to ensure that each and every guest has the most memorable experience that is enhanced by going the extra mile through providing the world\-class service our hotels are known for.

* Go the **EXTRA** mile in our efforts
* Be **RESPECTFUL** to our guests and colleagues
* Deliver service in a **CARING** fashion
* Be **OUTSTANDING**
* Express your own personality – Create your **LEGACY**
* Be your **NATURAL SELF** – Be genuine and sincere with the guest and colleagues

 **Who you would be working for**


Maybourne Hotel Group owns and manages Claridge's, The Connaught, The Berkeley, The Maybourne Riviera, The Emory and The Maybourne Beverly Hills – six of the world's most renowned luxury hotels.


Our hotels have histories that stretch back over a century. And, while each one retains its timeless appeal and individual nature, we are committed to ensuring they are always in tune with the wants and wishes of today’s discerning guests.


A warm welcome and cool spirit define The Maybourne Beverly Hills, the newest member of our hotel family.

jobs.description:
Founded in 1977 as the Senior Care Action Network, SCAN began with a simple but radical idea: that older adults deserve to stay healthy and independent. That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.


Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. With nearly five decades of experience, we have built a distinctive, values\-driven platform dedicated to improving care for older adults.


Our work spans Medicare Advantage, fully integrated care models, primary care, care for the most medically and socially complex populations, and next\-generation care delivery models. Across all of this, we are united by a shared commitment: combining compassion with discipline, innovation with stewardship, and growth with integrity.


At SCAN, we believe scale should strengthen—not dilute—our mission. We are building the future of care for older adults, grounded in purpose, accountability, and respect for the people and communities we serve.

**The Job**


Operational support for the Integrated Care Delivery Sales team, including supporting lead generation, campaigns, member communications, and data analysis.

**You Will**

* Support the Integrated Care Delivery sales team with building relationships with leadership and key stakeholders in Assisted Living, Memory Care, and Skilled Nursing Facilities and with initiating opportunities for sales presentations, community events, and other resident activities within communities.
* Support the development and execution of sales and marketing campaigns.
* Assist in producing reports that accurately measure, track and analyze enrollment and production date for Integrated Care Delivery sales reps.

* Knowledge of Medicare/Medicaid and/or nursing community dynamics

jobs.description:

Kareway Products, Inc. is a growing beauty company specializing in K\-beauty skincare and health and beauty products sold through major national retailers. Our portfolio includes innovative facial masks, skincare treatments and trend\-driven beauty products developed for the U.S. retail market.

Project Access provides programs and services to over 27,000 children, families, and seniors living in affordable housing communities across the country. We strive to empower residents of affordable housing communities through our onsite services, aiming to create pathways for self\-reliance and personal growth.

 **The opportunity**


The Resident Services Coordinator designs and implements programs that enhance community life for residents of all ages. They serve as a vital link between residents and services, creating value through targeted initiatives that address community needs. This role requires an innovative, proactive individual who excels in an autonomous environment, driving positive long\-term outcomes through an understanding of the communities in which they serve.

**What you'll do**

* Implement core programs and services, which include connecting, engaging, and empowering residents across four initiatives: Economic Stability, Education for Youth \& Families, Health \& Wellness, and Community Building.
* Conduct outreach and survey resident needs through community engagement aligned with our four pillars.
* Coordinate and oversee an after\-school program and teen program encompassing homework assistance and educational enrichment activities.
* Independently plan, prepare, and facilitate resident\-facing workshops and group sessions. When external partners are unavailable, deliver core topics directly to maintain consistency and resident engagement.
* Develop \& maintain partnerships with local providers to deliver services and workshops.
* Plan \& facilitate community\-building events that foster safe and meaningful relationships between community members.
* Provide residents with information \& referrals to access community resources and services, specifically connecting residents with nonprofit partners who deliver services within our four pillars framework.
* Support food distribution needs in the community, including maintaining food bank partnerships and distribution management.
* Develop and maintain strong relationships with the property management team, scheduling regular communication sessions.
* Organize and conduct monthly outreach requirements including door\-to\-door outreach, digital/virtual outreach, and physical presence in high\-traffic locations.
* Recruit, select, train, and oversee volunteers and interns who support programming at the Resource Center.
* Use personal automobile to acquire program supplies and donations and attend offsite meetings (mileage reimbursed at IRS rate).
* Publish monthly newsletters and calendar of events.
* Collect \& submit program outcomes data with emphasis on social impact data collection to measure outcomes within our four pillars.
* Provide input and adhere to budgets for resident service programs, including authority to utilize funds for contractors when needed.

**What you'll bring**

* **Bilingual English/Spanish required**
* Two years of experience in multi\-family housing or related fields such as social services or community outreach; or a Bachelor's Degree in Social Work, Human Services, or related field.
* Experience in both:
* + after\-school programs or educational settings for youth
	+ serving diverse populations, demonstrating cultural competency and community awareness
* Proficient with MS Office (Excel, Word, Publisher, Outlook). Basic with Adobe Acrobat, Canva, Salesforce, Concur.
* Strong time management, administrative, and organizational skills.
* Self\-starter, multi\-tasker, and strong communicator
* The physical activity of this position includes minimal bending, walking, kneeling, reaching, and step climbing. Able to lift up to 30 pounds, which includes large boxes of food for a supplemental food distribution program.

**Credentials/Certifications**
==============================

* Valid Driver’s License, clean driving record, and current automobile insurance
* CPR \& First Aid certified (or obtained within 90 days of hire)
* Successful completion of background check and LiveScan

**The details:**

* **This is a part\-time (29 hrs/wk), non\-exempt position**
* **Schedule:** Monday through Thursday: 11pm – 5:30pm, Friday: 12:30pm – 5:30pm. Ability to work an occasional Saturday for an event. Schedule is subject to change.
* **Location**: Triada Apartments, 616 N. Lacy St., Santa Ana CA 92701

	+ Safe Harbor 401(k) with 4% company match
	+ Pro\-rated paid time off \+ 14 paid holidays

**PRODUCTION COORDINATOR**



REPORTS TO: PRODUCTION MANAGER



STATUS: NON\-EXEMPT





**Summary**



Boot Barn is where community comes first. We thrive on togetherness, collaboration, and belonging. We build each other up, listen intently, and implement out\-of\-the\-box ideas. We celebrate new innovations, congratulate one another's achievements, and most importantly support each other.


At Boot Barn, we work together to make a positive impact on the world around us, and by working collectively with encouragement, we consider ourselves “Partners.” With the values of the West guiding us, Boot Barn celebrates heritage, welcomes all, and values each unique Partner within our Boot Barn community.





Our vision is to offer everyone a piece of the American spirit – one handshake at a time.


The Production Coordinator is an entry\-level member of the Creative Production team and is responsible for supporting the day\-to\-day coordination of Boot Barn ecommerce studio photography and production logistics. Reporting to the Production Manager, this role helps keep ecommerce shoots organized, on schedule, and accurately reflected within the team's ecommerce calendar and production systems.


The Production Coordinator will primarily support in\-studio ecommerce photoshoots by maintaining shoot calendars, coordinating schedules, updating production information, communicating changes, and assisting with general studio logistics. This role will also support the Production Manager with travel accommodations, production\-related administrative tasks, and other coordination needs across the department.





The ideal candidate is highly organized, dependable, detail\-oriented, and eager to build a career in creative production. This person should be comfortable working within established processes, managing recurring deadlines, communicating clearly with cross\-functional teams, and supporting a fast\-paced studio environment.


**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**


* Coordinate day\-to\-day scheduling and logistics for ecommerce studio photoshoots.
* Maintain the ecommerce production calendar, ensuring shoot dates, product categories, talent, studio details, and other production information are accurate and current.
* Prepare and communicate daily and weekly shoot schedules, schedule changes, and production details to studio teams and appropriate internal partners.
* Coordinate models, photographers, stylists, studio teams, and other shoot participants, including scheduling and confirmations.
* Partner with Ecommerce, Creative, Photography, Styling, Merchandising, and other teams to gather necessary information and ensure teams are prepared for upcoming shoots.
* Identify missing information, scheduling conflicts, or production needs and follow up with appropriate partners or escalate as needed.
* Support studio production needs before, during, and after ecommerce shoots.
* Coordinate production\-related travel, including airfare, hotels, ground transportation, and itineraries.
* Maintain organized production documentation, shared files, schedules, and vendor and talent contact information.
* Assist with production\-related purchase orders, invoices, receipts, and expense documentation.
* Support the Head of Production with campaign, location, and special project production needs as assigned.
* Demonstrates high level of quality work, attendance and appearance.
* Demonstrates high degree of professionalism in communication, attitude and teamwork with customers, peers and management.
* Adhere to all local, federal and state laws in addition to Company policies, procedures, and practices.
* Performs any other duties that may be assigned by management.


Requirements:
**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's Degree in Marketing, Communications, Fashion, Photography, or a related field preferred, or equivalent relevant experience.
* 1\-2 years of experience in production, ecommerce, photography, marketing, retail, studio operations, or a related field preferred.
* Previous internship, coordinator, administrative, or studio experience is a plus.
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage recurring deadlines and multiple priorities.
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to maintaining accurate calendars, schedules, and production information.
* Comfortable working within calendar, scheduling, and project management systems.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to follow established processes and effectively communicate changes or issues to the appropriate partners.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office and ability to learn internal production and ecommerce systems.
* Ability to work collaboratively within a fast\-paced studio and creative environment.
* Strong follow\-through and willingness to take ownership of assigned tasks.
* Ability to remain flexible as shoot schedules and production priorities change.
* Interest in ecommerce, photography, fashion, retail, and creative production preferred.
* Ability to work occasional extended hours or support production schedules as business needs require.

**Competencies**

* Organization \& Attention to Detail: Maintains accurate calendars, schedules, documents, and production information while consistently following established processes.
* Communication: Communicates clearly and professionally with internal Partners and external production contacts and shares updates in a timely manner.
* Reliability \& Follow\-Through: Takes ownership of assigned tasks, meets deadlines, and follows through on production needs and outstanding items.
* Adaptability: Responds positively to changing schedules, priorities, and production needs within a fast\-paced environment.
* Collaboration \& Teamwork: Works effectively with the Head of Production and cross\-functional Partners to support efficient ecommerce studio operations.

**Boot Barn Benefits \& Additional Compensation Opportunities**


* Competitive hourly

Who We're Looking For

We want someone with **B2B inside sales experience** who understands that building a successful book of business takes consistent effort.

The right person is:

* Competitive and highly self\-motivated
* Comfortable proactively pursuing new business
* Persistent without being discouraged by rejection
* Naturally good at building business relationships
* An excellent communicator on the phone and through email
* Organized and disciplined with follow\-up
* Able to identify opportunities and move quickly
* Motivated by financial success
* Interested in building something over the long term rather than simply collecting a paycheck
* Able to work independently while also contributing to a team

Experience selling pharmaceuticals, medical supplies, healthcare products, or other B2B products is valuable, but **industry experience is not required if you have demonstrated B2B sales ability and are willing to learn.**

Compensation

This position is intentionally **commission\-heavy with a smaller base salary.**

We want our salespeople to have meaningful upside when they perform. Your earning potential will be driven largely by your ability to develop accounts, generate profitable sales, and grow your book of business.

**High performers will have the opportunity to earn substantially more than they would in a traditional salary\-heavy sales position.**

What Success Looks Like

In the beginning, success means **activity, persistence, and account development.** You should expect to spend significant time prospecting, contacting potential customers, and creating new relationships.

Over time, the goal is to **build a valuable book of repeat customers.**

We want our salespeople developing relationships that produce repeat orders, referrals, larger opportunities, and long\-term revenue.

As your customer base grows, your role will increasingly shift from pure prospecting toward **managing and expanding the relationships you've created.**

This Position Is a Great Fit If...

You are the type of salesperson who looks at a commission plan and thinks about the upside rather than the guarantee.

You enjoy competing.

You like developing relationships but aren't afraid to pursue new business.

You want your income to increase as your skills, customer base, and sales increase.

And most importantly, **you want an opportunity where exceptional performance is rewarded.**

If you're talented, hungry, persistent, and ready to build a serious book of business in the pharmaceutical and medical supply industry, we want to hear from you.

We are a thriving nonprofit network of 23 free, public charter schools open to all students. The Operations Coordinator supports a safe, orderly, and joyful environment at KIPP Bridge Academy by executing consistent student culture and campus operations routines throughout the school day. Reporting to the School Leader, this role maintains a visible presence across campus, builds positive relationships with students, and supports systems that keep students safe, engaged, and in the appropriate learning environment.


In this role, you execute assigned tasks with quality and on time, working within a scope set by others. You decide how to approach your work and escalate anything outside it.

* **Supports** attendance and re\-engagement systems, including assigned campus sweeps and student\-location checks, so students return to and remain engaged in instructional spaces.

### **Arrival, Dismissal \& Lunch Operations**

* **Executes** assigned arrival, dismissal, and lunch procedures so students move safely and school routines remain predictable and efficient.
* **Supports** lunch supervision and student expectations for movement, use of space, cleanliness, and behavior so non\-instructional periods remain safe and welcoming.
* **Escalates** significant conflicts, safety concerns, and operational breakdowns according to established protocols so school leaders can intervene when needed.

### **Campus Operations \& Systems**

* **Completes** regular campus\-readiness checks of common areas, student spaces, signage, supplies, and assigned safety\-related needs so the campus is prepared for students and staff.
* **Maintains** accurate records and systems for assigned inventory, equipment, supplies, and student\-facing materials so operational resources remain organized and available.
* **Tracks** recurring operational gaps or breakdowns and communicates them to school leadership so the team can determine appropriate improvements.
* **Supports** implementation of established and new campus routines so operational expectations are applied consistently across the school.

### **Student \& Family Community**

* **Supports** a positive school climate by building trusting relationships with students while maintaining clear adult boundaries and consistent expectations.
* **Executes** student recognition and relationship\-building practices so students experience encouragement, accountability, and connection to the school community.
* **Supports** student culture activities, assemblies, community events, and other schoolwide programming so students and families experience a welcoming and connected school community.
* **Maintains** respectful, culturally responsive, and age\-appropriate communication with students, families, and staff so community members feel known, safe, and respected.
* Other duties as assigned.

**About Us:**
-------------


**AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal.**
--------------------------------------------------------------------

Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now.


Our customers include category\-defining companies like Lovable, Ramp, Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub\-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low\-latency inference, fine\-tune models, and access production\-ready sandboxes at scale.


We recently raised a $355M Series C at a $4\.65B valuation, led by General Catalyst and Redpoint Ventures. We've crossed $300M\+ ARR and grown fivefold since September.


Our team includes creators of popular open\-source projects (e.g., Seaborn, Luig**i**), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders


**About the Role**
------------------


We're hiring the first Account Managers at Modal. You'll report to the Regional Director of Account Management and be a founding member of the team.


This function does not exist yet. There is no playbook, no territory map, no established motion. You'll own a book of business from day one and build the motion at the same time — from fast\-moving AI startups to large enterprise teams running critical infrastructure on Modal.


This is a commercial role with a revenue target. You'll be measured on retention and expansion across your accounts. While you won't be delivering the technical recommendations and implementation, the work is technical by nature. Our customers are engineers running GPU workloads, inference, and batch jobs in production, and you need to hold your own in those conversations.


The profile we're hiring is a technical account manager. You've worked at companies that are deeply technical and consumption in nature. You bring the commercial instincts to grow revenue from an existing base and enough technical depth to know which conversation actually matters. And you can credibly work with a CxO all the way down to a Developer.

--------------------


* **A founding seat.** You're helping build the AM function with us, not joining one that already runs. The account plans, expansion motions, and customer cadence you and the rest of the founding team figure out are what we scale to every AM we hire after you.

* **A book of business.** You’ll own a set of accounts and be responsible for the revenue that comes from them. Expect to be meeting with customers in your first few days because the best playbooks are built from real experiences.

**What the Role Is Not**
------------------------


* **A traditional post\-sales role.** You're measured on revenue, not health scores.
* **An on\-call support function.** You're not fixing bugs or triaging tickets. You're driving growth.
* **A technical delivery role.** You're not implementing for the customer. You know where the technical work goes and you pull in the right people.
* **An inherited motion.** Nothing is handed to you. If you identify gaps in process, tooling, or a playbook — you help build it.
* **A single\-lane job.** Our priorities go customer company team me. We focus on delivering maximum impact vs. "this is my job".

**What You'll Achieve**
-----------------------


* Build Modal's account management function and iterate on it as we scale the business
* Own and deliver on a revenue target across your book of accounts
* Grow an account's first use case, expand into a second, and drive standardization across the Modal platform
* Get fluent enough in Modal to hold your own with engineering teams on their workloads, and know when to pull in FDEs, Support, or Product
* Work with Sales, Solutions Architects, FDEs, Support, and Product to grow accounts and feed customer signal back into the roadmap
* Travel to customers as needed to support key accounts and drive expansion opportunities

**What You'll Need to Bring**
-----------------------------


* **Customer\-facing experience.** You've owned a revenue target or supported a revenue target in a highly technical, consumption business.
* **Technical depth.** You work autonomously with Developers through CxOs and understand the core parts of the developer tech stack.
* **AI builder.** You're hands on building with AI tools — not just consuming workflows that were built for you.
* **Ownership.** You run your book of business and projects like you're the CEO of it. You're highly organized bringing stability, predictability, and pace to your work. You take action vs. waiting for direction.

* **Cross\-functional partner.** Low ego, easy to work with, and highly accountable. You ask for feedback, you act on it, and you'd rather be corrected early than right late. Internal teams love working with you.

jobs.title: Key Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============



Concert Health is the leading national behavioral health medical group committed to integrating the Collaborative Care model into existing health care practices to improve patients' lives. We believe everyone, regardless of location or insurance, should have easy access to personalized, high\-quality behavioral health support that is guided by the provider they trust.


### **Who You Are**



You are a seasoned account leader who is energized by depth over breadth — you'd rather go deep on a smaller portfolio of complex, high\-value accounts than manage a wide book with less context on each. You build real fluency in each partner's clinical operations, stakeholders, and goals, and you use that fluency as the foundation for everything else: faster issue resolution, sharper growth strategy, and smoother provider onboarding.



You're equally comfortable being hands\-on and thinking several moves ahead. Day to day, you're the named point of contact partners trust to resolve issues and keep commitments on track. At the same time, you're building the data\-backed case for why a partner should expand, and running the onboarding plan for the next provider joining the account — moving between all three without losing sight of the relationship that ties them together.



You bring the judgment and track record of someone with 9\+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, or Client Services in healthcare, with a career trajectory into progressively larger and more complex accounts. You've driven measurable growth in existing accounts (not just retention), ideally onboarded new sites, providers, or users into a live account, and you're credible in a room with C\-suite and senior clinical leadership. Beyond your own accounts, other Account Managers look to you for how the job should be done — you set the standard, not just meet it.


### **Job Summary**



The Key Account Manager owns the complete lifecycle of Concert Health's most strategic partnerships — day\-to\-day relationship management, long\-term account growth, and the onboarding of new providers within existing accounts. This is Concert Health's most advanced individual\-contributor role in Account Management: one person, accountable end\-to\-end for a focused portfolio of high\-value, high\-complexity accounts, trusted to move fluidly between hands\-on servicing, strategic growth planning, and program\-managed provider launches without ever dropping the relationship thread.


**Core Responsibilities:**


*Own Day\-to\-Day Partner Success \& Issue Resolution:*


* Serve as the primary, named point of contact for a focused portfolio of key accounts, ensuring timely, high\-quality responses across clinical, operational, and administrative needs
* Proactively identify, triage, and resolve issues – driving toward systematic, scalable solutions rather than one\-off fixes
* Coordinate cross\-functional resources (clinical, operations, product, billing) to remove barriers and maintain momentum within each account
* Establish clear accountability, follow\-through, and communication loops so nothing falls through the cracks for your accounts
* Maintain deep, current fluency in each key account's clinical operations, stakeholders, and performance, so day\-to\-day servicing and long\-term strategy are always working from the same picture


*Grow Key Accounts*


* Own overall account performance for your portfolio – clinical, operational, and financial – with direct accountability for growth, not just retention
* Use utilization, outcomes, and financial data to identify white\-space opportunities within each key account and translate them into a concrete growth plan
* Build and pitch data\-backed growth and expansion cases to partner leadership, framing clinical outcomes and financial performance into a compelling case for investment
* Translate partner goals into actionable success plans with clear milestones and measurable outcomes, and hold both internal teams and partners accountable to them
* Lead negotiations with partner stakeholders to convert growth opportunities into signed, executed expansion


*Manage Leadership \& Executive Relationships*


* Build and maintain strong, trust\-based relationships with executive sponsors and senior clinical stakeholders at each key account
* Lead regular business reviews, presenting performance insights, outcomes, and growth recommendations
* Confidently navigate complex, matrixed stakeholder environments, aligning priorities and driving decision\-making
* Act as a strategic advisor, influencing partner leadership to invest in and expand Collaborative Care as a core model across their organization


*Set the Standard for the Function*


* Serve as a thought partner and mentor across the Account Management team, setting the bar for how account growth and provider onboarding should be done
* Define and codify the playbooks, frameworks, and best practices that other Account Managers are trained on
* Represent the voice of key accounts in product and clinical program roadmap discussions, with the credibility to shape how those roadmaps are prioritized
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, ownership, and urgency – anticipating challenges before they arise and acting decisively to keep accounts on track


**Qualifications:**


* 9\+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or Client Services, with a demonstrated trajectory into progressively larger and more complex accounts
* Healthcare experience required
* Demonstrated success balancing hands\-on day\-to\-day account servicing with longer\-term strategic growth planning
* Proven track record driving measurable expansion or growth revenue within existing accounts, not just retention
* Experience onboarding or implementing new sites, providers, or users within an existing customer account preferred
* Strong foundational understanding of the healthcare delivery system in primary care and administrative/

jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**


This role sits within the Edge Product area of Accenture Global IT, acting as the primary account management and product liaison between Dell and the wider Accenture organization. The role manages the day\-to\-day Dell relationship, represents Accenture's interests in product and roadmap discussions, and ensures alignment between Dell's offerings and Accenture's internal edge, data center, and infrastructure modernization priorities.

**Key Relationships**

* Global IT Edge Compute
* Global IT IMS Leadership
* Global IT Strategy, Architecture and Innovation
* Accenture Dell Account Management Team

**Key Responsibilities**

**Dell Account \& Relationship Management**

* Own and manage the day\-to\-day relationship with Dell account contacts, acting as the primary point of contact for account\-level matters.
* Coordinate commercial discussions, including hardware pricing, licensing tiers, and contract matters, escalating decisions appropriately.
* Track and follow up on outstanding commercial items (e.g. hardware pricing, licensing tier decisions) and ensure resolution within agreed timelines.
* Support business review cycles and executive\-level engagements with Dell stakeholders.

**Internal Accenture Liaison**

* Act as the internal conduit between Dell and relevant Accenture stakeholders across Global IT, infrastructure, and edge teams.
* Support cross\-functional coordination on active workstreams, ensuring Dell\-related dependencies are tracked and communicated.
* Prepare and maintain materials (briefings, status updates) that keep internal stakeholders aligned on Dell\-related decisions and timelines.
* Flag unresolved decisions and dependencies proactively rather than allowing them to surface unaddressed to senior stakeholders.

**Product Roadmap Input \& Liaison**

* Gather and relay Dell product roadmap information relevant to Accenture's edge and infrastructure strategy.
* Provide structured input from Accenture's perspective into Dell's product planning where relationship and process allow.
* Support development of outcomes\-led, exec\-ready materials on edge infrastructure topics, translating technical detail appropriately for the audience.


Remote with with air travel associated with role 5 times a year (e.g. Conference, meetings)


  

**Here's What You Will Need**

* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in account management, partner/vendor management, or a similar relationship\-facing role, ideally with a major hardware/infrastructure vendor (e.g. Dell).
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience managing or coordinating complex, multi\-stakeholder commercial engagements, including contract governance or procurement processes.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience with data center, edge computing, or hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) concepts.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate's Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience.)

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience working within or alongside a major enterprise IT function or shared services environment.
* Familiarity with Nutanix, VMware, or similar HCI platforms, even at a conceptual level.
* Exposure to AI infrastructure, GPU compute platforms, or edge compute deployments.
* Experience supporting or contributing to vendor business reviews, RFPs, or contract renewals.
* Knowledge of IT governance frameworks or compliance processes within large enterprises.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to operate across both commercial and technical conversations.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and tracking multiple open items to resolution.
* Ability to synthesise technical and commercial information into clear, concise updates for senior leadership.
* Self\-directed with strong organisational discipline; capable of managing competing priorities across a distributed team and vendor landscape.
* Collaborative working style with the ability to build trusted relationships both internally and externally.

jobs.title: Client Account Manager
jobs.description:
Trusted empowers the healthcare workforce with technology\-first solutions to optimize the clinical workforce. By combining our AI\-powered staffing platform with dynamic labor marketplaces, we help leading employers automate the matching and fulfillment of clinical staff\-driving down labor costs and reducing administrative burden. Our mission, to help people everywhere get care, has support from top institutional investors such as Craft Ventures, Felicis Ventures, Stepstone, and Founder Collective as well as healthcare innovators like Texas Medical Center, Mercy Health, Intermountain Ventures, and Town Hall Ventures.

**What we're looking for:**


You will use your direct experience as a Recruiter or Account Manager in the Travel Nursing Industry to serve as a partner and key collaborator with our clients to understand their staffing needs. You will proactively solve problems, fill open jobs, and ultimately grow these strategic relationships to maintain and expand our business. The Account Manager will take initiative, setting objectives and creating actionable plans to deliver results. You will be a resourceful, solution oriented problem\-solver, expertly navigating areas such as how and when jobs are posted, upcoming projects or staffing challenges, what the job submission requirements are, and the interview and offer process cadence. You will remove barriers where possible and work collaboratively with the product and Nurse Advocate teams to increase our submission\-to\-offer rate. The Account Manager will be the day\-to\-day relationship support required to place and retain Clinicians.

**Your responsibilities:**

* Maintain trusted relationships with assigned clients, resulting in a 100% retention rate of current and future accounts.
* Meet assigned targets for growth.
* Develop new relationships that result in successful additions to our client roster.
* Gather and track feedback from clients and create reports on the health of relationships and opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with leadership on the Nurse Advocate team to improve standing with clients through higher quantity and quality of placements.
* Proactively identify and offer solutions to barriers for growth in our accounts and placements.

**Who you are:**

* **Strategic\-thinker.** You anticipate future trends, helping the team to understand and use complex analyses to achieve goals. You clearly distinguish and leverage the organization’s key differentiators, incorporating them into a solid long\-term strategy. You are highly alert to the future, developing hypotheses and enabling their team to address change, tackle challenges and capture new possibilities. You see the big picture in a relationship and know how the little things you do today to provide value can create big things down the road.
* **Customer\-focused.** You champion the needs of clients, helping team members deepen insight into customer needs. You have a long\-term understanding of client needs, building roadmaps with measurable outcomes that address current and anticipated problems.
* **Influencing \& Persuading.** You make it a priority to broker relationships and forge connections that contribute to others success and advance Trusted's goals.
* **Personable and reliable.** You can create and grow relationships with key stakeholders by providing value and meeting their needs in order to grow these relationships.

**You have:**

* 3 or more years of experience in healthcare staffing with direct experience working with RNs, either in Account Management or Recruitment, preferably at a high\-growth startup and/or a healthcare or staffing company.
* Experience in building and maintaining strategic relationships and growing a book of business with RNs through excellent presentation and communication skills with the ability to hold challenging conversations.
* Knowledge and understanding of the healthcare staffing landscape and buyers (VMS/MSP/Direct).
* Knowledge of compliance criteria and Joint Commission requirements for RN professions.
* Worked cross\-functionally and enjoy working as a team to achieve a goal.
* A High School Diploma is required, Associate's or Bachelor's Degree preferred.

**We offer:**

* Paid vacation \& sick time, paid family leave, and flexible work hours
* Employer\-paid health insurance, vision, and dental
* Employer\-paid life insurance
* Monthly cell phone reimbursement
