**Position TitleLocationJob Description**  

IT Trainer (Hybrid Work) \| \[Various within State of Georgia, GA] \| Seeking a candidate who can travel to District and Area Office locations in District 1 (Gainesville), District 2 (Tennille, GA), to conduct on\-premise classes several times a month and conduct classes remotely online through Microsoft Teams. Details on District locations can be found here: https://www.dot.ga.gov/GDOT/Pages/GDOTDistricts.aspx . The job will be to deliver IT training to staff (adult learners) on custom IT developed and Commercial\-Off\-The\-Shelf (COTS) applications. GDOT will train the candidate in these products. Candidate will deliver training for desktop, web, and mobile applications. Candidate will work with GDOT users to identify training needs, courses, and content. Candidate will publish training schedules/course offerings within GDOT Learning Management System (Oracle/Workday), administer learner enrollments/testing/completions, assign grades/scoring or awarding of certifications. Candidate will send and review training surveys to obtain feedback to improve training delivery and GDOT IT products. Candidate will collaborate/develop relationships with GDOT business units to increase class enrollments and address technical needs. Candidate will also facilitate vendor or contractor delivered training. The candidate will develop/update/maintain IT training content. They will compile information to create PowerPoint presentations, IT Trainer Guides, Quick Reference Guides, User Manuals, Storyboards, Videos, and/or Computer Based Training. Candidate will engage technical staff to develop training content. GDOT highly desires a candidate who can develop training content using Microsoft Word, Microsoft PowerPoint, Scribe, TechSmith Camtasia, Adobe Captivate, and/or Articulate 360/Storyline.Candidate will complete recordkeeping for tracking time/activities, timecards, performance indicators, and ensure submitted data is accurate.Candidate will be working as a team member within the IT organization of GDOT and report to a Team Leader/Supervisor. The IT Training Team is composed of IT Trainers, Instructional Designers and a Team Leader. The team delivers training statewide on \~40 applications. Training courses cover a variety of transportation topics such as contract administration, material testing, construction inspections, asset management/maintenance, and emergency operations. **Core Competencies:**• Training: Employs a variety of instructional techniques; effectively obtains learner engagement; delivers competency\-based learning; actively seeks feedback to improve.• Content Development: Produces high quality training content quickly with minimal rework.• Communication: Routinely and effectively communicates with GDOT learners/customers; with Team Leader on work assignments/priorities, timelines, risks/issues, travel issues, etc.• Teamwork and Cooperation: Supports their team and IT to accomplish common goals, objectives, projects, and tasks. Demonstrates a “can\-do” or “team player” attitude. Assists in conducting scheduled classes when other instructors are unable to conduct (e.g. call in sick).• Customer Service: Provides helpful, courteous, responsive, and knowledgeable service. Ensures customer IT needs/issues get routed to appropriate support staff/IT management. Demonstrates patience and empathy with learners. Honors commitments and provides follow\-up/follow\-through. Provides learning opportunities to meet GDOT business needs, offer the complete course catalog, and schedule classes equitably across Districts.• Results Orientation: Consistently delivers required business results; demonstrates successful attainment of performance indicators for courses, classes, and enrollments; sets and achieves achievable, yet aggressive goals; consistently complies with quality standards in meeting deadlines; maintains focus on achieving GDOT IT goals/objectives.• Planning and Organization: Plans schedules, work assignments, and travel arrangements sufficiently in advance. jobs.title: Special Education Compliance Program Coordinator - Georgia Connections Academy
jobs.description:
**School Summary**

Georgia Connections Academy is a tuition\-free, full\-time virtual school for students in grades K\-12 throughout Georgia. The school is authorized by the Georgia Charter Schools Commission and governed by an independent Board of Directors, with a mission to maximize academic achievement for students who are seeking other academic options. The school is operated by Georgia Connections Academy, a nonprofit corporation, through a contract with Connections Academy of Georgia, LLC, to provide its educational program and other services. Connections Academy, a division of Connections Education, is accredited by AdvancED, and GACA is accredited by the Southern Association of Colleges \& Schools Council on Accreditation and School Improvement.


*Georgia Connections Academy strives to create an inclusive environment that welcomes and values the diversity of the people we serve. We foster fairness, equity, and inclusion to create a workplace environment where everyone is treated with respect and dignity.*

**Position Summary**

Working from the Duluth, Georgia, office and from your home office within Georgia, certified teachers at Georgia Connections Academy support and motivate students through high\-quality virtual instruction using the Pearson Online Classroom. Teachers deliver synchronous and asynchronous instruction, provide intervention and enrichment, engage families, and use data to drive student learning and growth.



All GACA teachers and staff must be able to regularly participate in required in\-person activities that may require overnight travel throughout the state of Georgia, including but not limited to:


* School and department meetings
* Student engagement events
* Professional development and required training
* State testing, Diagnostic testing, and all in\-person summative and formative assessments
* Graduation and other school\-level events


Staff may also be required to support virtual administration of assessments, as scheduled by the school.


**Position Overview:**

Working from the Duluth office, the Program Coordinator of Special Education Compliance will be key in organizing and managing new teacher orientation, overseeing mentoring programs, and providing ongoing support to educators throughout the year. Additionally, this position will assist the Director of Special Education with special education compliance, special education instruction, communications, and data management. The Program Coordinator will assist in the management of the Special Education Department and will be a point of contact for families of students with disabilities. The Program Coordinator of Special Education will be an expert in Federal and State Special Education regulations.



This is a 12\-month, full\-time position.


**Key Responsibilities:**


* Oversee Special Education Compliance Data;
* Assist the Special Education Leadership Team with audit reviews;
* Support professional development activities for case managers, teachers and school staff members;
* Manage and supervise special education case managers;
* Understand the requirements for and assist the state testing team to facilitate the administration of all district testing;
* Assist Special Education Leadership Team with the enrollment process including requesting appropriate paperwork and assuring all documents needed are obtained;
* Assist teachers when students enroll mid\-semester, making sure that teachers and case managers receive guidance on special education supports and services;
* Assist with the hiring and onboarding process of special education teachers and case managers;
* Assist with GO IEP organization and management, including onboarding and exiting students from platform, assisting with resolving support tickets, running regular compliance reports with follow up actions
* Other duties as assigned.


**Assessment \& Accountability**


* Administer formative and summative assessments, including monthly progress monitoring, CFAs, EOGs and EOCs where applicable.
* Participate in all required Georgia state standardized assessments in\-person and virtual sessions, including Georgia Milestones, ACCESS, Georgia Alternative Assessment, etc., in addition to End\-of\-Pathway, benchmarks, CFAs, and diagnostic assessments.
* Maintain accurate records of attendance, communication logs, academic progress, and intervention documentation.


**Collaboration \& Professional Practice**


* Work collaboratively within the Professional Learning Community to monitor data, plan instruction, and ensure student success.
* Partner with Advisory Teachers, School Counselors, Special Education staff, and team members to meet student needs and ensure strong communication loops.
* Support social, engagement, and community\-building activities—both virtual and in\-person—to cultivate belonging for students and families.
* Attend required school and district professional development and pursue ongoing growth in instructional practice.


**Community Engagement \& School Support**


* Assist in the organization and facilitation of school\-wide events (graduation, field trips, engagement activities).
* Participate in student recruitment efforts, marketing events, and family orientations as needed.
* Support the creation of a positive, inclusive virtual school culture through consistent communication, engagement, and community\-building practices.
* Perform other duties as assigned to support school operations, strategic initiatives, and student success.


**Essential Skills \& Competencies**


* Strong commitment to equitable practice, high expectations, and individualized student support
* Ability to use data to inform instruction and intervention
* Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills
* Effective collaboration within virtual and in\-person teams
* Strong organizational skills and timely completion of all required documentation
* Comfort with technology\-based instruction and virtual learning tools
* Fle

**Position:** Admin \& Operations Coordinator

 **Organization:** Administration \& Human Resources

 **Classification:** Non\-Exempt / Exempt

 **Reports to:** Operations Manager / Sr. Manager – Administration

 **Summary:** Vatic Outsourcing, a growing telecom consulting firm, is seeking a highly organized, dependable, and detail\-oriented Admin \& Operations Specialist to manage daily office operations, facilities management, and administrative workflows. This on\-site role is essential to maintaining seamless daily business activities, including local errands, vendor management, office upkeep, and basic financial support.

 **Major Duties and Responsibilities:**

 **Facilities \& Building Management**


* Oversee the daily upkeep, maintenance, and cleanliness of all office buildings.
* Coordinate and schedule routine inspections, maintenance, and emergency repairs for HVAC, plumbing, electrical systems, and office equipment.
* Act as the primary point of contact for property managers, cleaning crews, and third\-party facility vendors.
* Manage vendor contracts, negotiate service agreements, and review/approve facility\-related invoices.
* Plan and manage office layout changes, seating arrangements, ergonomic setups, and workstation prep for new team members.
* Maintain office inventory, track physical assets, order supplies, and manage repair logistics for office equipment.

  


**Daily Administrative \& Daily Operations**


* **Daily Local Errands:** Travel locally daily to the company PO box to collect physical mail and checks, and perform daily bank deposits at the local bank branch.
* Sort and distribute incoming physical mail and process all outgoing mail and package shipments.
* Handle core administrative tasks, including document management, electronic filing, data entry, and recordkeeping.
* Assist in planning and coordinating company events, celebrations, and philanthropic initiatives.
* Assist with internal operational communications, announcements, and office updates.
* Support HR functions such as recruitment coordination, onboarding, and employee engagement activities.
* Handle confidential information with professionalism and discretion.
* Serves as the receptionist for the office, greeting visitors and candidates for interviews.
* Prepare HR reports and documentation as needed.

  


**Financial \& Basic Operational Support**


* Process and deposit incoming physical checks at the local bank daily.
* Enter client payments into internal accounting tracking systems and QuickBooks.
* Assist with basic client invoicing, accounts payable tracking, and processing routine operational expenses.
* Handle confidential business and financial information with high discretion.

  


**Required Skills \& Abilities:**


* Must have a valid driver’s license, a reliable vehicle, and clean driving record for daily mandatory local trips (PO box and bank).
* Strong organizational, multitasking, and problem\-solving skills with high attention to detail.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), Google Suite, and basic accounting software (QuickBooks preferred).
* Hands\-on experience working with facilities vendors, maintenance technicians, and service contracts.
* Ability to work independently and manage daily routine responsibilities without constant supervision.

  


**Physical Requirements:**


* Prolonged periods sitting at a desk and working on a computer.
* Must be able to lift up to 25–30 pounds for handling packages, office supplies, and setup needs.
* Daily local driving required.

  


**Education \& Experience:**


* Two to three years of administrative, office operations, or facilities management experience preferred.
* Experience handling basic bookkeeping/QuickBooks or banking procedures preferred.
* High school diploma required; Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree preferred.

  


**Work Environment:**



This position is a 100% on\-site role operating in a professional office environment. Must be available in\-person daily to perform facilities checks and complete daily bank/PO box runs.

 **Supervisory Responsibility:** While there is not a formal responsibility for personnel management, this role will work closely with various members of internal peer and management organizations.

 **Additional Eligibility Qualifications**

  


* Work Authorization/Security Clearance (if applicable)
* Job contingent upon a background check

We value all employees’ talents and support an environment that is inclusive and respectful. We are strongly committed to this policy and believe in the concept and spirit of the law.

  



Vatic’ s policy is to provide equal employment opportunity to qualified persons without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, known mental and physical disabilities, or veteran status. Federal and state laws require this, and we believe equal employment opportunity is simply good business practice.

jobs.title: Bilingual Wholesale Sales Representative-English, Mandarin
jobs.description:
About Box Beauty

Box Beauty is a fast\-growing B2B wholesale platform focused on trending collectibles, blind boxes, licensed character merchandise, designer toys, plush, gifts, and lifestyle products.

We work with independent retailers, specialty stores, gift shops, beauty supply stores, toy and collectible stores, Asian supermarkets, convenience retailers, mall stores, and other local businesses looking for new and differentiated products.

We are expanding our local wholesale presence in the Atlanta market and are looking for a hands\-on Field Sales Representative who enjoys getting out into the market, meeting store owners, building relationships, and turning product interest into repeat business.

This is not a desk\-only sales role.

You will spend a significant amount of your time visiting local retailers, introducing products, following up with existing accounts, helping customers place orders, and developing long\-term wholesale relationships.

\#\# The Opportunity

Box Beauty already has an established local operating partner in Atlanta, including access to warehouse capabilities and an existing network of retail customers.

The Atlanta market has shown demand for our product categories, but many local retailers still prefer face\-to\-face service, local product availability, and direct support instead of purchasing entirely online.

Your job will be to help turn that opportunity into a strong local wholesale business.

You will initially focus on:

\* Following up with an existing pool of local retail customers

\* Visiting stores and developing relationships with owners and buyers

\* Introducing new products and best\-selling items

\* Helping retailers place first orders and reorders

\* Expanding Box Beauty's customer base throughout Metro Atlanta

\* Learning which products, categories, and price points perform best locally

Over time, this role may become a key part of a larger Atlanta wholesale operation, including a potential local showroom / warehouse store.

\#\# What You Will Do

\#\#\# Existing Account Development

A major part of this position will be working with existing retail relationships and warm customer leads.

You will:

\* Contact and visit existing retail accounts

\* Reintroduce inactive customers

\* Understand what each store currently sells

\* Identify products that fit each customer's business

\* Present new arrivals and in\-stock merchandise

\* Follow up after initial conversations

\* Help customers place wholesale orders

\* Encourage reorders based on previous purchases and product performance

\* Maintain ongoing relationships with store owners and buyers

This role is not just about opening accounts.

We care strongly about whether customers reorder and become long\-term BoxBeautycustomers.

\#\#\# Local Field Sales

You will regularly visit retailers throughout the Atlanta area.

Typical target customers may include:

\* Toy and collectible stores

\* Gift shops

\* Anime and pop\-culture stores

\* Beauty supply stores

\* Asian supermarkets

\* Lifestyle retailers

\* Independent convenience stores

\* Specialty retailers

\* Mall stores and kiosks

\* Independent neighborhood retailers

You should be comfortable walking into stores, introducing yourself, speaking directly with owners or buyers, and developing new relationships from the ground up.

\#\#\# Product Presentation

You will learn Box Beauty's product assortment and help retailers understand which products may fit their stores.

This includes:

\* Blind boxes

\* Designer toys

\* Character merchandise

\* Plush

\* Keychains

\* Collectibles

\* Gifts

\* Lifestyle products

\* Trend\-driven merchandise

You do not need to be an expert in every product category on day one.

However, you should be curious about products, retail trends, and what makes merchandise sell in different types of stores.

\#\#\# Sales Follow\-Up

Many wholesale sales are not closed during the first conversation.

You will be responsible for consistent follow\-up, including:

\* Phone calls

\* Text messages

\* Email

\* In\-person visits

\* Product updates

\* New arrival notifications

\* Reorder reminders

We are looking for someone who is organized and persistent without being overly aggressive.

\#\#\# New Account Development

In addition to working with existing relationships, you will identify and develop new retailers throughout the Atlanta market.

You may:

\* Visit retail districts and shopping centers

\* Identify potential wholesale customers

\* Build local prospect lists

\* Ask for referrals from existing customers

\* Develop relationships with store owners and local retail groups

\* Introduce Box Beauty to businesses that do not currently buy from us

\#\#\# Market Feedback

Because this is a developing market for Box Beauty, your feedback will be extremely valuable.

You will help us understand:

\* Which products customers respond to

\* Which products do not perform well

\* Which retail segments have the strongest demand

\* Common objections from buyers

\* Competitive products and pricing

\* Customer preferences

\* Demand for local pickup

\* Demand for same\-day or local warehouse fulfillment

\* Opportunities for new product categories

We expect our first Atlanta Field Sales Representative to help us build not only sales, but also a better understanding of the Atlanta wholesale market.

\#\# What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured only by how many stores you visit.

We will look at several areas, including:

\* Number of qualified retailer conversations

\* Number of store visits

\* New accounts activated

\* Sales generated

\* Repeat orders

\* Reorder rate

\* Active customer growth

\* Customer retention

\* Quality of customer relationships

\* Local market coverage

As the territory develops, monthly sales goals will become an increasingly important part of the role.

Our goal is to build a repeatable, profitable Atlanta wholesale business

* Manage and oversee all operations including property maintenance, capital improvements, rent collections, lease administration, budgeting, and marketing.
* Develop, mentor, lead, and manage a high\-performing, cohesive team.
* Maintain accurate records of all community transactions and submit them on a timely basis (i.e., rent rolls, delinquency reports, move\-in/move\-outs, etc.).
* Assist in the preparation and development of annual property management operating budget.

* Generate necessary legal action, documents, and process in accordance with State and Company guidelines.
* Ensure that A/P invoices are submitted to the corporate office for payment; handle petty cash and all funds.
* Confirm all leases and corresponding paperwork are completed and input to the property management software system accurately and on a timely basis.
* Lead emergency team for the community. Ensure proper response and handling of all community emergencies with staff, residents, buildings, etc. within company guidelines to minimize liabilities.
* Develop and/or implement resident retention programs (i.e., resident functions, special promotions, monthly newsletters, etc.).
* Maintain community appearance and ensure repairs are noted and completed on a timely basis.
* Ensure that all service requests are recorded and communicated appropriately to maintenance.
* Responsible for ensuring that all personnel in all departments always operate within OSHA (Occupational Safety \& Health Act) standards and company safety policies.
* Purchase and authorize contracts in accordance with budgetary guidelines.

* Bachelor's degree preferred, or 5 years related experience or equivalent combination of education and experience in property management.
* Minimum of 5 years property management experience.
* Minimum of 5 years on\-site as a Leasing Consultant and/or Assistant Property Manager; may consider 3 years’ supervisory experience in a Customer Service\-related business with appropriate certification(s).

The Clinical Research Coordinator assists with the study recruitment process, including screening and obtaining consents from eligible candidates. Supports study conduct throughout the lifecycle of the study. Supports and maintains the integrity and quality of clinical research, by ensuring that research is conducted in accordance with Good Clinical Practice (GCP) Guidelines, federal and sponsor regulations and guidelines, institutional policies and procedures, and study protocol.  

**Typical Duties**  

 Maintains accurate and timely documentation and actively communications with investigators, colleagues, study participants, sponsors, IRB, and other research related entities as needed.  

 Ensures study\-related procedures are executed per protocol and performed in accordance with protocol timelines.  

 Participates in study recruitment, including identifying and screening research participants for study eligibility  

 Implements processes to ensure study\-related procedures are executed per protocol and performed in accordance with protocol timelines  

 Obtains consent from research participants and ensures participants understand the protocol and what is expected of them while participating  

 Identifies adverse events based on gained knowledge and reports them in a timely and accurate manner to the principal investigator and appropriate regulatory authorities (IRB, sponsor, etc.)  

 Maintains source documents in accordance with institutional procedures  

 Packages and ships study\-related specimen and/or samples in accordance with Cook County Health System, International Air Transport Association (IATA) and sponsor guidelines  

 Obtains and organizes supplies needed to complete study tasks  

 Proactively identifies and participates in training, continuing education, and development activities to broaden knowledge and enhance professional development  

 Keeps up to date on relevant State and Federal research guidelines and regulations  

 Manages risk to the organization(s) and principal investigators by ensuring up\-to\-date training and compliance in accordance with complex state and federal regulatory statues and rules  

 Manages variety of work requiring critical attention to detail and prioritization **Minimum Qualifications**  

 Associate degree from an accredited college or university or higher  

 Two (2\) years in a clinical research or relevant experience  

 Proficiency using Microsoft Office (Excel and Word) **Preferred Qualifications**  

 Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university **Knowledge, Skills, Abilities and Other Characteristics**  

 Knowledge of medical terminology  

 Knowledge of GCP concepts  

 Knowledge in setting up, coordinating, and managing clinical research studies  

 Knowledge and understanding of policies, procedures, and regulations governing human subject research  

 Knowledge and understanding of the Federal regulations and guidelines governing the protection of human subjects (e.g., FDA, OHRP, GCP/ICH guidelines, and HIPAA regulations) prior to interacting with research subjects  

 Knowledge of components of clinical research operations, including study implementation, oversight, and coordination  

 Knowledge of CRF completion, and documentation standards, including timely and accurate transcription of study data  

 Ability to analyze, organize, and prioritize work under pressure while meeting deadlines  

 Ability to maintain confidentiality  

 Skill in completing assignments accurately and with attention to detail  

 Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills  

 Ability to work independently and/or in a collaborative environment  

 Proficient in understanding phases of clinical trials
 Demonstrate an understanding of clinical research compliance

jobs.title: Executive & Personal Operations Assistant
jobs.description:
Executive \& Personal Operations Assistant

**Part\-Time \| Hybrid \| Naperville, Illinois**  
**Approximately 15–20 hours/week \| $25–$35/hour**

I’m an entrepreneur and founder looking for an exceptional person who genuinely **loves getting things done**.

This is not a traditional corporate Executive Assistant position. I’m looking for someone who gets real satisfaction from taking a long list of tasks, bringing order to it, figuring things out, and making things disappear from my plate.

I have a lot of ideas, projects and moving pieces. I’m looking for the person who loves the other side of that equation: **organizing, completing, following up and closing loops.**

A significant part of this position involves **computer and backend administrative work**, so you should genuinely enjoy working on a computer, learning new tools and solving little technology problems.

You don't need to know how to do everything already. You do need to be the kind of person who thinks:

**“I don't know how to do that yet, but I'll figure it out.”**

Some of your work can be done independently from home. I also want someone who lives close enough to **Naperville to work alongside me in person approximately 1–2 times a week** when needed.

What you might help me with

* Organizing Google Drive, documents and folders so things are actually easy to find
* Managing spreadsheets, lists and trackers
* Keeping projects and outstanding tasks organized
* Updating databases and contact lists
* Scheduling appointments and coordinating calendars
* Completing online forms and applications
* Uploading, downloading and organizing documents and materials
* Formatting documents and presentations
* Researching information online and summarizing what you find
* Following up with people and keeping track of open items
* Preparing materials for meetings
* Printing, scanning and organizing paperwork
* Helping coordinate travel, reservations and logistics
* Using ChatGPT and other AI tools to work faster and smarter
* Basic Canva or similar tools
* Helping with occasional personal administrative tasks
* Troubleshooting the random technology and administrative problems that inevitably come up
* Noticing something that needs to be done—and taking care of it before I have to ask

You may love this role if...

You **love a checklist** and get satisfaction from checking the last box.

You are the person friends ask when they can't figure something out on their computer.

A messy Google Drive doesn't scare you—it makes you want to organize it.

You notice details other people miss.

You don't need someone constantly reminding you what needs to be done.

If I say, **“Can you figure this out for me?”** your instinct is to start researching rather than tell me why it can't be done.

You enjoy bringing order to lots of moving pieces.

You communicate clearly when something needs my decision, but you don't need my approval for every small decision.

You are warm, trustworthy, discreet and dependable.

You are comfortable learning new technology and using AI.

And most importantly, you genuinely enjoy **finishing things and closing loops**.

Experience as an executive assistant, personal assistant, administrative assistant, operations coordinator or project coordinator is wonderful, but I care just as much about **resourcefulness, judgment, technology skills, attitude and follow\-through** as I do about your résumé.

The details

This position will initially be approximately **15–20 hours per week**, with flexibility in how those hours are structured.

Some work can be remote, with approximately **1–2 in\-person working sessions per week in the Naperville area**.

Compensation is approximately **$25–$35/hour**, depending on experience and capabilities.

There may be an opportunity for the position and hours to grow over time if we are a great fit.

Final candidates may be invited to complete a **paid working interview** so we can both experience what it would actually be like to work together.

To apply

Please send:

* A brief introduction about yourself and **why this particular position caught your attention**.
* An example of something complicated, disorganized or unfamiliar that someone handed you and **you figured out**.
* The computer programs, technology and AI tools you feel most comfortable using.
* Your approximate weekly availability.
* Your desired hourly rate.
* A casual **60–90 second video introducing yourself**. Nothing polished—we simply want to meet you.

And please answer this question:

**Imagine you arrive Monday morning and I give you 25 unfinished tasks, a messy Google Drive, three things that need research, several people who need follow\-up, and two things that are urgent. What would you do first?**

We're ultimately looking for the person we can confidently say:

**“Give it to them. They'll figure it out.”**

Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15\.0 – 20\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Naperville, IL 60563

They must identify selling opportunities and assertively act upon the opportunities that offer maximum potential and/or gross profit \- both with existing customers through cross\- and range\-selling as well as with new leads. They must uphold Brenntag's core values and focus on customer excellence in all regards every day.

**Job Description:**

**Customer Business Development (70%)**

* Meet sales objectives and focus on customer retention as well as improving overall customer satisfaction (also through digital channels).
* Identify customer potentials, i.e., opportunities for cross\- and range\-selling to existing customers and engage relevant stakeholders (e.g., Brenntag Specialties sales staff).
* Set strategies and targets for growth of customers in assigned territory (sales plan); align with Sales Manager.
* Frequently conduct customer visits and prepare the meetings using all available tools and reports, coordinate, negotiate and close proposals.
* Manage spot business/rush offers, get support from Commercial Assistant when necessary.
* Liaise with relevant stakeholders to create in a timely manner the best solution for the customer and extract maximum value (e.g., Sales Management/Product Management for Pricing topics).
* Act as major point of contact to customers in assigned territory in all commercial matters.
* Conduct market studies on potential new product opportunities by contacting customers to gather interest and test market demand.
* Leverage Brenntag Connect to generate and maximize sales.

**New Customer Generation (10%)**

* Spot opportunities for launching sales projects in cooperation with other departments like Product Management.
* Identify and prioritize prospective customers.
* Get in contact with prospects and involve relevant stakeholders to nurture leads down the pipeline.
* Liaise with Brenntag Specialties sales staff on customers with new Brenntag Essentials business opportunities.

**Sales \& General Admin (15%)**

* Set and maximize prices considering value\-based pricing and customer segmentation within guidelines provided by Product Management.
* Ensure appropriate data administration and documentation of all business cases in the local CRM system (e.g., post processing of visits, creation of customer projects).
* Update and maintain customer opportunity pipelines and potentials in the CRM system
* Complete sales and revenue\-related reporting.
* Drive commercial and functional excellence based on guidance/input from Commercial Excellence Function.
* Provide regular forecasts of product demand from customers to Product Management to optimize projected demand requirements.

**Know\-How Management (5% to\-be)**

* Maintain an up\-to\-date level of product knowledge, e.g., via training.
* Keep up to date with changes and updates in the product portfolio and in the market.
* Keep up to date on feedstock and upstream developments that impact product price movements.

**Your Profile**
================

**Education and Experience:**

* Preferably Post\-Secondary Education with a focus in Business, Science or equivalent.
* Experience in the chemical distribution business, preferably in a sales capacity (3 to 5 years previous experience in sales role).

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Are you looking for limitless career opportunities with a company that values growth, innovation, and teamwork?** At Ntiva, we’re more than a Managed Services Provider, we’re a community dedicated to helping each other, our clients, and their businesses thrive both personally and professionally. Ntiva is a culture of people who are passionate about the work…and each other.



Our clients view us as an essential part of their teams, relying on us for strategic guidance, fast solutions to complex challenges, and proactive support. With strategic locations across the U.S. and leadership from our founder, Steven Freidkin, we’re on the front lines of a fast\-paced industry, facing cybersecurity threats and rapid technology changes together.



If you thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment and enjoy going above and beyond, we’d love to meet you. Come explore one of our many opportunities and grow with us!


**How you will make an impact**



As the Account Manager (AM), you own the client relationship. This is the highest leverage seat in Client Success. Clients trust you to understand their business, connect their technology to where it is going, and make sure Ntiva delivers. You are not a messenger between the client and internal teams. You are the decision bearer in the room. The role is focused on four outcomes: clients who stay because risk was caught early, revenue that grows through disciplined roadmap execution and clean agreements, an expansion pipeline you qualified yourself, and time reclaimed from reactive work and spent on strategy instead.

  


**Location and work expectations**


* Hybrid role in the Chicagoland area, approximately 80% remote and 20% client visits. Allocation may fluctuate based on business needs.
* Must be able to travel by car to client locations, with a valid driver’s license and an insured vehicle.
* Monday through Friday, approximately 8am to 5pm CST.

  


**What you will be doing**


**Own the relationship**


* Own a defined book of business, generally $2M to $2\.5M in annual recurring revenue across approximately 25 to 30 clients, sized by client tier mix and role level.
* Carry the relationship at the executive level. Show up prepared and on time, with an agenda and a written follow\-up summary, and hold the room.
* Run escalations behind the scenes rather than in front of the client, communicate in the language of the client’s business rather than the ticketing system, and maintain a living map of each client’s decision maker, economic buyer, champions, and blockers.


**Drive the strategy**


* Understand how each client makes money, and translate their business objectives into a 12 to 24 month technology roadmap.
* Lead the prescribed engagement cadence for your book of business, including Service Reviews, Strategic Cadences, Technology Business Reviews, and Annual Reviews, leading with the client’s business context rather than a report on Ntiva activity.
* Position new services as answers to a problem you have already diagnosed, and qualify expansion opportunities before engaging solution architect or professional services time.
* Identify at\-risk clients early using defined risk signals, and produce a written save plan before a contract conversation becomes necessary.


**Own the commercials**


* Read and reconcile a client invoice, and explain every line without escalating internally.
* Own renewals end to end: the right mix of services, a current agreement stack, migration off legacy SKUs, and statements of work precise enough that Onboarding can execute without chasing.
* Apply credit discipline as if the margin were your own, recognize when service recovery beats a credit, and use client profitability as an input to account strategy.
* Engage past due clients with clarity and speed, and own your part of accounts receivable tickets end to end with current notes.


**Partner internally**


* Know the services matrix and which team owns which work, including when to engage the solution architect, vCIO, IT Advisor, and Service Delivery, and when not to.
* Qualify work before engaging peer teams, hand off cleanly with confirmation of receipt and an explicit next step, respect peer team process rather than routing around it, and hold peer teams accountable respectfully through a defined path to a defined person.
* Bring client feedback back to Ntiva teams with the diagnostic work done and a solution proposed. Advocacy is not echo. Set client expectations early and hold the line, including saying no, and train clients on how to engage Ntiva.


**Manage your capacity**


* Manage your time so every client receives what they are entitled to, adhere to scheduled block time, and build the week around proactive work rather than inbox reaction.
* Delegate to the right team rather than carrying work by default, push clients toward self\-service where it serves them well, and use approved AI tooling and published documentation for summaries, follow\-up drafting, and routine reconciliation where appropriate.
* Work in ConnectWise Manage fluently across the AM workflow, keep ticket notes current so peer teams see movement without asking, and execute renewals, service additions, and decommissions per process.

  


**How success is defined in this role**


* **CORE values.** Care: outcomes over transactions, and a client who is struggling or unusually quiet is a signal to act on. Ownership: you are accountable from first engagement through renewal, including the fix that prevents a repeat. Responsiveness: you reply within a business day and update proactively. Empathy: you hear the concern before offering the solution.
* **Four behaviors.** Strategic Thinking: technology serves the client’s business goals, and you apply patterns across your portfolio. Proactive Engagement: you surface issues before they escalate and deliver value between formal touchpoints. Internal Advocacy: you represent client interests without damaging relationships with colleague

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager - Semiconductor
jobs.description:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.


With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.


Remote within the United States with 40\-60% travel to customer sites and MSS facilities.

**Role Overview:**


Based in the US the Strategic Account Manager is directly accountable to our Semiconductor Metrology and Inspection Key accounts for Material Science solutions (MSS) in North America. You aren’t just a "point of contact"—you are a business partner responsible for aligning the customer’s project timelines to our operational capacity and bringing in new product introduction wins (NPI).


You will be finding, championing and winning opportunities our core technologies in optics, laser machining and mechatronics within these key customers. You will use key tools such as 80/20 and MEDDPICC to deliver accelerated growth to MSS.


This role will represent 14 MSS factories to our customers with special focus on: CVI Laser Optics, IDEX Health and Science Rochester, Louwers Hanique and Millux.

**Key Responsibilities:**


Opportunity Identification \& Growth

* Execute our strategic intent through to 2030\. Understand the ways and means we will grow our platform and leverage them within your customers to build new opportunities.
* Pipeline Development: Identify within our key accounts the urgent and immediate pain which MSS can solve. Align MSS and customer business roadmaps. Turn these activities into business opportunities
* Strategic Upselling: Drive "share of wallet" growth by introducing existing customers to new technologies, materials, or service offerings.
* Achieve year\-on\-year incremental share increases in alignment with goals and priorities set by Key Account director and Metrology and Inspection Sales director.


NPI \& Project Alignment

* Drive timely and accurate completion of MEDDPICC and 80/20 process for incoming requests and outgoing quotes
* Ideation to Production: Lead the "speed advantage" strategy, ensuring that new projects move through the design phase without operational bottlenecks.
* Align the customer’s need timeline with our production scheduling to ensure projects are delivered on time to launch.
* Requirement Alignment: Act as the voice of the customer to critical needs are fully incorporated into solution offering.


Forecasting \& Demand Planning

* Data Integrity: Build and maintain 12\-month rolling demand forecasts to drive raw material procurement and factory capacity planning.
* Risk Mitigation: Identify gaps between customer forecasts and actual PO placement, flagging potential under\-utilization or capacity "crunches" before they occur.


Internal Operational \& Customer Alignment

* Conduct regular face to face meetings with key customer stakeholders to review new business opportunities, business reviews, customer quality, scorecard feedback and to discover customer intelligence.
* Act as the main escalation path for customer concerns on factory performance.
* Constraint Management: Regularly sync with the Production, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to understand current floor capacity, equipment downtime, and material lead times.
* Constraint Synchronization: Partner with the Enterprise Solutions Engineering Team to ensure that customer quality constraints and delivery schedules are realistic and executable.

**Candidate Profile:**

* 5\+ years semiconductor OEM/account management experience
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* High technical fluency in one or more of Semiconductor metrology inspection tools, optics, laser machine processing, high voltage feedthroughs or precision machining.
* Basic computer skills required, including facility with Microsoft Office and experience with custom CRM and ERP systems
* Ability to consistently represent the business in the best light in all circumstances.
* The "Hunter" Mentality: Proven ability to find and close new business opportunities within a technical or industrial landscape.
* Manufacturing IQ: Deep understanding of the production lifecycle, including lead times, supply chain constraints, and the NPI process.
* Analytical Rigor: Ability to synthesize complex data into accurate forecasts using ERP software and Advanced Excel functions.
* Communication Mastery: The ability to say "no" or "not yet" to a customer in a way that preserves the relationship while protecting the business’s operational integrity.


Certain positions with IDEX Corporation and its business units require access to controlled goods and technologies subject to the International Traffic in Arms Regulations or the Export Administration Regulations. Applicants for these positions may need to be "U.S. Persons," as defined in these regulations. Generally, a "U.S. Person" is a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent resident, or an individual who has been granted refugee or asylum status.


Are you ready to join a different kind of company where our people, our culture, and our commitments are centered around providing trusted solutions that improve lives around the world?

**Total Rewards**


The compensation range for this position is $112,700\.00 \- $169,100\.00, depending on experience. This position may be eligible for performance based bonus plan.**Benefits Package**


Our comprehensive U.S. benefit offerings include: Health benefits, 401(k) retirement savings program with company match, PTO, and more. More information on our benefits and rewards can be found on our career page: https://www.idexcorp.com/careers/our\-benefits\-and\-rewards/

jobs.description:

At Avnet, relationships matter. We are a global, FORTUNE ® 500 technology distributor and solutions company that delivers design, supply chain and logistics expertise to customers at every stage of a product’s lifecycle. Our employees have a front row seat to the latest innovations shaping the world we live in and the future we share. We’re driven to help our customers around the world succeed and we do so by earning the trust of some of the biggest names in technology.


Working at Avnet means being a part of a global team. We work collaboratively and with integrity, doing business the right way. For more than a century, we have partnered together to help our customers, suppliers and teammates realize the transformative possibilities of technology. Experience what’s next at Avnet!

Field sales executive focused on customers to achieve revenue and margin goals in assigned accounts. Identifies customer needs and applies company’s value proposition to drive sales growth and improved profitability. Develops strategic relationships and aligns customer and business goals, creating and managing a business and execution plan for shared success among the customer, vendor partners and the company.

 **Principal Responsibilities:**

* Serves as the primary point of contact for the customer interface to the company's resources that drives and supports high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty, as measured in surveys and share of wallet.
* Develops strong, strategic relationships with customer(s) to identify and leverage the customers’ business goals, growth strategies and profit drivers to deliver the appropriate business value proposition sales solution strategy.
* Provides leadership and guidance in critical customer planning and engagement.
* Performs critical customer analysis to identify and leverage the partner’s marketing programs to achieve growth in their customer’s solutions capability.
* Engages customer(s) in joint planning that integrates the company's services, programs and supplier partnerships securing customer commitment for the development of a comprehensive investment in strategies that advance the company’s market position, entanglement and financial goals
* Conducts regular business reviews with assigned accounts to track progress toward revenue and growth goals and owns execution of business plan.
* Maintains and monitors pipeline and metrics for assigned customers, performs analysis and identifies improvement opportunities.
* Supports supplier's strategies by aligning solutions with customer to maximize profitable growth, and customer expansion.
* Prioritize customers and opportunities with greatest potential for success.
* Closely manages profitability by minimizing profit leaks and maximizing gross profit.
* Other duties as assigned.

 **Job Level Specifications:**

* Solid understanding of business, financials, products/services, the market, and the needs of assigned accounts. Understands emerging market trends and interdependencies impacting customers; leverages understanding to expand relationships with own customers. May be recognized as an expert in one area.

Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; may serve as team lead and help develop colleagues' and customers' understanding. Has autonomy to set and negotiate product/service terms; plans own territory or account approach.
* Collaborates with team and leadership. Has direct contact with clients and decision makers; participates in team sales for major accounts.
* Leads the negotiations on medium\-sized, complex accounts; plans own territory or account approach. Works within broad guidelines and policies to develop business with new and existing customers

 **Work Experience:**

* Minimum experience required is typically 5\+ years with bachelor's or equivalent.

 **Education and Certification(s):**

* Bachelors degree or equivalent experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained.

  

\#LI\-AMER

Our employees work hard to live our values and help us grow. * Paid Holidays

Since launching in 2019, Starface has turned the historically negative experience of having acne into a more joyful, relatable one with a category of its own: expressive and effective products that make people feel good. ### **this role is for you if**

At Apptegy, we are more than a tech company; we are partners dedicated to transforming how schools communicate and shape the future of education. Your work here will directly empower districts to share their stories, engage their communities, and celebrate student success. We're a team of thoughtful, high\-performing individuals committed to making a tangible impact. If you're looking for a dynamic environment where you'll be supported with exceptional mentorship and resources to grow your career, come build with us.
### **The Role**


As a Sales Development Representative at Apptegy, you will create meaningful connections between school leaders and our team. You’ll own high volume, multichannel prospecting across phone, email, video, and conferences, as well as research target accounts to build a healthy pipeline for the sales team.


You’ll also be excited to embrace AI as a powerful prospecting partner, using it to uncover insights, sharpen account strategies, personalize outreach, and work smarter.


You will work closely with your manager, teammates, and Account Executives to build interest, schedule qualified demos, share prospect insights, and help advance opportunities in your territory.


We’re looking for someone who brings curiosity, creativity, and a collaborative spirit to prospecting. You’ll have room to experiment with new ideas, learn quickly, and use feedback to continuously sharpen your approach.


Many of our Sales Development Representatives joined Apptegy without prior sales experience, so if you’re ready for a challenge and excited to grow, we encourage you to apply!


### **What You’ll Do**


* Execute high\-volume, multi\-channel prospecting through cold calls, email, and conferences, including approximately 80 dials per day and potentially travel to conferences 1–2 times per month.
* Research accounts, identify pain points and root causes, and determine what will compel a prospect to engage and meet with Apptegy using proven frameworks.
* Generate qualified leads and healthy pipeline while consistently working toward meeting and exceeding quarterly quotas through disciplined execution and personal accountability.
* Partner closely with Account Executives in assigned territories, sharing prospect intelligence and helping advance opportunities.
* Use AI thoughtfully and responsibly to improve account research, personalization, efficiency, and effectiveness.
* Participate actively in call reviews, drills, and coaching; apply feedback quickly, test creative approaches, and adapt based on prospect responses.
* Communicate clearly and proactively with prospects, teammates, Account Executives, and cross\-functional partners while contributing to a high\-performing team.

### **What You’ll Bring**


* A four\-year college degree or comparable continuous work experience with an impressive track record of success.
* Hunger to grow your career and interest in building a long\-term career in sales.
* Motivation to work in an intense, high\-accountability sales environment and take ownership of your success.

new_jobs.title: Social Media Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
**Social Media Coordinator**

The Social Media Coordinator is responsible for bringing the Los Angeles Ale Works brand to life across social media. This role plans and creates engaging content, manages day\-to\-day publishing and community interaction, and captures the beer, food, events, people, and atmosphere that make each LAAW location distinctive.

The right candidate is creative, organized, comfortable working independently, and energized by being on\-site. This person will work closely with our taprooms, brewery, kitchen, events, and leadership teams to maintain a consistent content calendar and timely social presence. This is a social\-media\-first position; broader marketing projects, may be supported as needed but are not the primary focus of the role. Candidates must share our commitment to quality, craftsmanship, creativity, and authenticity.

The ideal candidate will be knowledgeable about beer, hospitality, Los Angeles culture, social media scheduling platforms, and have experience in project management, writing, photography, and video.

**PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

● Plan and maintain a consistent social media content calendar aligned with beer releases, food specials, events, collaborations, and beer production.

● Create original photography, short\-form video, Stories, Reels, captions, and other platform\-specific content for Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and emerging channels.

● Visit Los Angeles Ale Works locations regularly to gain an understanding of the location and capture authentic, timely content featuring products, guests, employees, events, and behind\-the\-scenes activity.

● Schedule and publish content while maintaining a consistent brand voice, visual style, and level of quality across platforms.

● Monitor comments, messages, tags, reviews, and user\-generated content; respond or route issues to the appropriate team in a timely and professional manner.

● Build community engagement by identifying relevant local conversations, partners, creators, organizations, and cross\-promotional opportunities.

● Coordinate with internal teams to gather accurate information, assets, dates, and priorities for upcoming posts and event coverage.

● Create simple digital graphics and promotional assets for social media using Canva or Adobe.

● Track platform performance and provide clear, practical reporting on reach, engagement, audience growth, and content performance.

● Use performance insights and platform trends to recommend content improvements and test new formats or ideas.

● Maintain an organized library of approved photos, videos, graphics, and reusable content.

● Provide support for related digital and in\-store promotional needs when they directly support social campaigns, beer releases, or events.

● Manage time independently with the ability to toggle between daily and long\-term tasks, keeping workstreams moving forward simultaneously.

● Maintain open lines of communication, patience and professionalism when partnering with cross\-functional teams in a fast\-paced evolving environment.

**QUALIFICATIONS:**

● One to three years of experience managing social media or creating content for a hospitality, food and beverage, lifestyle, entertainment, or consumer brand.

● Strong working knowledge of Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Google Business, and common social scheduling and reporting tools.

● Demonstrated photography, short\-form video, editing, and copywriting skills; a portfolio or examples of past work are preferred.

● Proficiency with Canva; working knowledge of Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator, Lightroom, Premiere Pro, or similar tools.

● Highly organized, detail\-oriented, and able to manage a content calendar, multiple locations, and quick\-turn requests.

● Clear written and verbal communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively across departments.

● Sound judgment when representing a brand publicly and responding to guests online.

● Self\-motivated, social, dependable, and comfortable taking initiative while remaining open to feedback.

● A degree in communications, media, marketing, journalism, or a related field is preferred but not required.

● Flexibility in both schedule and duties; willingness to work weekends, evenings, as needed along with traveling between our Hawthorne, Culver City and Hermosa Beach locations

Pay: $30\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Employee discount
* Flexible schedule
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Retirement plan
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply

new_jobs.description:
At Compass, our mission is to help everyone find their place in the world. Founded in 2012, we’re revolutionizing the real estate industry with our end\-to\-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to seller and buyer clients.


As a Transaction Coordinator, you will join the Contract to Close team, which oversees all administrative details throughout the contract process, freeing agents to focus on building client relationships and growing their business. Our Transaction team members are experienced in real estate and serve as the first point of contact for all parties involved, ensuring a smooth path to settlement. From document preparation to deadline tracking to requesting online testimonials, your goal is to make life easier for agents and clients every step of the way. You will also work hand in hand with local lenders and title attorneys, bringing extensive experience and strong industry contacts to every contract you process.
  

**Please note: This position will require you to be in the local office 2x per month.**
  

At Compass, You Will:
* Handle document tracking for a large volume of real estate transactions from listing to close, and/or contract to close, ensuring compliance with brokerage and legal requirements — averaging roughly 25\-30 closings per month
* Ensure real estate contracts are processed properly and promptly, with a focus on the details
* Manage and track contract deadlines to ensure all timelines are met
* Navigate company systems to validate the accuracy of compliance and commission records
* Provide support to Agents in response to inquiries regarding commission payouts, deductions, and commission calculations
* Collaborate with sales managers and other support teams to offer outstanding support to the agents

What We're Looking For:
* Real estate license preferred
* Strong knowledge of the real estate laws in California and familiarity with standard real estate forms used in California (SFAR, PRDS, and Local Area Disclosures)
* In\-depth knowledge of Real Estate Transaction Coordination and Compliance
* DocuSign, Google Suite, CTM
* Strong written, quantitative, verbal, and presentation skills
* Ability to digest detailed contracts and make informed decisions based on content
* Ability to maintain strict confidentiality of agents' contracts
* Work independently and collaboratively in a team environment
* Customer service\-oriented personality
* Impeccable attention to detail and problem\-solving skills
* B.A. or B.S. degree preferred

**Compensation:** The base pay range for this position is $31\.25 \- $34\.71/hr; however, base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. Bonuses may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to a full range of benefits. Base pay is based on market location. Minimum wage for the position will always be met.


**Perks that You Need to Know About:**


Participation in our incentive programs (which may include eligible cash, equity, or commissions). Plus paid vacation, holidays, sick time, parental leave, and recharge leave; medical, tele\-health, dental and vision benefits; 401(k) plan; flexible spending accounts (FSAs); commuter program; life and disability insurance; Maven (a support system for new parents); Carrot (fertility benefits); UrbanSitter (caregiver referral network); Employee Assistance Program; and pet insurance.

  

**Do your best work, be your authentic self.**
At Compass, we believe that everyone deserves to find their place in the world — a place where they feel like they belong, where they can be their authentic selves, where they can thrive. Our collaborative, energetic culture is grounded in our Compass Entrepreneurship Principles and our commitment to diversity, equity, inclusion, growth and mobility. As an equal opportunity employer, we offer competitive compensation packages, robust benefits and professional growth opportunities aimed at helping to improve our employees' lives and careers.

new_jobs.description:
**Title:** Marketing Events Coordinator
  
**Department:** Marketing
  
**FSLA Grade:** Hourly (Non\-Exempt), Part\-Time
  
**Salary:** $26\.00 \- $29\.00 per hour
  
  

**Statement of the Job:**  

Assist the Manager of Promotions \& Partnerships in planning, coordinating, and executing promotional marketing events, community activations, and partnership initiatives that support programming at Walt Disney Concert Hall, Hollywood Bowl, The Ford, and off\-site events throughout Greater Los Angeles. As a key representative of the LA Phil, this role builds relationships with community organizations, promotional partners, and audiences while delivering impactful marketing events that expand access to the performing arts and strengthen community engagement across Los Angeles.
  
  

**Estimated Event Volume:**  

This position will support 34 pre\- and post\-concert events and approximately 20 tabling/community activation events. Event volume may vary based on LA Phil’s programming, partnerships, and community engagement opportunities.
  
  

**Essential Functions:**  

* Coordinate and execute marketing events (Drinks in the Garden, Casual Fridays, Chamber Tuesdays, etc.) at Walt Disney Concert Hall and on\-/off\-site activations and partner events for the Hollywood Bowl, The Ford, and community events in Greater LA
* Coordinate with internal teams (The Music Center, Production, Hollywood Bowl Ops, Creative Services, IT, and the Community and Government Engagement) for space availability, crew needs, signage, technology, and event logistics for set ups and breakdowns.
* Coordinate planning meetings with stakeholders on a regular basis to update on production timeline, budget, and troubleshooting if necessary.
* Coordinate and oversee events on the day of, including problem\-solving, welcoming guests, directing event setup, communicating with staff, organizing vendors, and managing takedown.
* Work with supervisor to manage the budget and ensure event stays within guidelines; ensure vendors are paid.
* Coordinate and execute off\-site promotional events and community activations for the Hollywood Bowl and The Ford in collaboration with cultural organizations, community partners, and promotional partners, including Amoeba Music, Smorgasburg, and other local organizations.
* Secure additional staff as needed.
* Transport promotional materials, signage, tents, tables, giveaways, and event equipment to and from activation sites using a personal vehicle.
* Represent the LA Phil professionally while engaging with patrons, community organizations, sponsors, and promotional partners.
* Assist with grassroots marketing initiatives including brochure distribution, community outreach, Corporate Partnerships activations, and neighborhood engagement.
* Create wrap\-up reports for events with detailed notes on improvements and key findings.
* Coordinate with legal, health, and safety obligations with The Music Center or other operations staff.
* Update internal master calendar with events.
* Maintain regular and reliable attendance, including availability for assigned event dates, evenings, and weekends as required by the event schedule.
* Assist with day\-to\-day tasks for the promotions team as needed, including asset management, brochure distribution, and outreach.
* Other duties as assigned.


**Relationships:** Creative Services, Corporate Partnerships, Hope \& Grand Events by Lucques Catering, Music Center Scheduling, Production, Operations, Hollywood Bowl Food \+ Wine.
  
  

**Reports To:** Manager, Promotions \& Partnerships
  
  

**Requirements:**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* Minimum of two (2\) years of experience coordinating events, marketing activations, or community outreach, preferably in the Greater Los Angeles area.
* Experience in audience development, grassroots marketing, promotions, or partnership marketing is highly preferred.
* Excellent project management, organizational, and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously while meeting strict deadlines and budgetary constraints.
* Detail\-oriented with demonstrated ability to multitask and bring time\-sensitive projects to completion.
* Capable of working as a member of a team as well as independently.
* Bilingual proficiency, Spanish is strongly preferred, as this role regularly engages with diverse communities and cultural organizations.
* Must possess a valid California driver's license, maintain a reliable personal vehicle, and have automobile insurance. This position requires travel and the ability to transport marketing materials, promotional items, signage, displays, and other event equipment to and from various venues.
* Ability to lift and transport up to 40 pounds and assist with event setup and breakdown.


**Event Schedule and Coverage:**  

* Event dates will be shared in advance. The Coordinator is expected to attend assigned events, including evenings and weekends as needed. If coverage is needed, the Coordinator must notify the Manager at least two (2\) days in advance whenever possible.


An Equal Opportunity Employer

They will be expected to achieve sales goals by developing and executing on their territory business plan, maintaining, and growing referral sources, coordinating sales efforts with strategic manufacturing partners, and supporting the needs of our customers. The RAM will also partner with the Strategic Account Executive to achieve growth in major health systems.

  

The successful candidate will have a proven track record of achieving results, building relationships, customer focus, and promoting all sales and marketing programs. Job will require occasional evening and weekend event attendance.

  

This is customer\-facing sales position, and you will be expected to travel to clinics and hospitals to meet your customers in the Los Angeles market. **Candidates are preferred to live in or within a 20 mile radius of Los Angeles.**

 **Primary Responsibilities:**

* Achieve the territory sales goals through effective business planning, sales execution and fully leveraging our customer selling model
* Promote a patient\-centered culture that strives to exceed needs, requirements, and expectations by educating and developing rapport with external customers
* Utilize available sales and market data to identify key customers
* Identify \& build relationships with key customers in target accounts
* Demonstrate a thorough understanding of disease state and treatment options and their impact on patients, payers, institutions, health systems and healthcare providers
* Collaborate with key internal stakeholders (Intake, Operations, Nursing) to execute on key selling strategies
* Be a Problem solver with a willingness to think creatively to achieve solutions
* The ability to partner closely with Strategic Account Executive to achieve joint growth targets in identified large health systems

  

You'll be rewarded and recognized for your performance in an environment that will challenge you and give you clear direction on what it takes to succeed in your role as well as provide development for other roles you may be interested in.

**Required Qualifications:**

* 2\+ years of business\-to\-business selling experience
* Reside in the Los Angeles Metro Area
* Consistent track record of top sales performance (top 30%)
  

* Proven ability to drive results in a challenging and ambiguous market by building a book of business from scratch
* Driver's License and access to a reliable transportation

 **Preferred Qualifications:**

* Medical or Specialty Pharmacy sales experience (ex. Pharmaceuticals, medical device, lab sales)
* Experience selling infusion products as manufacturer and/or infusion pharmacy
* Demonstrated experience working individually and as a Team to achieve results
* Proven solid team player that has a customer service approach and is solution oriented
* Proven tenacious and motivated outside\-the\-box thinker who excels in a collaborative team setting

  

Pay is based on several factors including but not limited to local labor markets, education, work experience, certifications, etc. In addition to your salary, we offer benefits such as, a comprehensive benefits package, incentive and recognition programs, equity stock purchase and 401k contribution (all benefits are subject to eligibility requirements). No matter where or when you begin a career with us, you'll find a far\-reaching choice of benefits and incentives. The salary for this role will range from $60,000 \- $130,000 annually based on full\-time employment. This role is also eligible to receive bonuses based on sales performance. We comply with all minimum wage laws as applicable.

new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS is seeking a world class sales professional to manage and grow our global business relationship with one of the largest entertainment and technology companies in the world.  

  

This Global Account Manager role will have a primary focus on the customer’s media and entertainment lines of business, responsible for business development and account growth for this global account. The ideal candidate brings deep industry expertise, a builder mindset, and the ability to engage C\-suite stakeholders with credible, outcome\-driven conversations — while thriving in a highly collaborative, cross\-functional environment.  

  

The pursuit and management of net new customer relationships and incremental line\-of\-business opportunities will be critical to the success of this role. You will build and maintain key relationships, develop and manage opportunities, monitor deployment projects and engage resources to scale. You will define a CXO relationship strategy across the account and engage AWS senior leadership executive sponsorship and alignment, advancing a strategic business partnership and maintaining a trusted advisor relationship at all levels of the customer organization.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

The Global Account Manager (GAM) is responsible for teaming with the customer’s Line\-of\-Business (LOB) and IT Organizations to build strategic relationships across the account. The GAM is responsible for selling at the most strategic levels within the account and implementing a broad strategy for earning customer trust and service implementation. The GAM will work with all appropriate AWS resources (Executives, Solution Architects, Business Development, Marketing, Partners, Support, Service teams and Professional Services) to support customer interests. This includes dotted line responsibility for downstream sales and technical resources that may be geographically distributed.  

  

Business Skills:  

* Strategic account planning and executive relationship building
* Ability to articulate business value for cloud solutions
* Strong collaboration across cross\-functional teams
* Experience with partner ecosystem
* Excellent presentation and communication skills

  

Cloud Knowledge:  

* Understanding of core cloud services relevant to sports workloads (compute, storage, databases, analytics, ML/AI, security)
* Familiarity with cloud partner ecosystems and Professional Services capabilities
* Ability to connect customer business challenges to cloud\-based solutions

  

Opportunity Development \& Execution:  

* Drive opportunities with a focus on measurable business outcomes
* Collaborate with industry specialists to evangelize cloud services, partner solutions, and Professional Services.
* Participate in executive engagements with C\-suite stakeholders

  

A day in the life  

About the team

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 7\+ years of direct sales or business development in software, cloud or SaaS markets selling to C\-level executives experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience creating and implementing long\-term transformational account strategies in a customer\-facing role or equivalent
* Experience collaborating with cross\-functional teams including Marketing, Product Management, Customer Service, Operations, Legal, Finance, and Senior Leadership
* 10\+ years of technology related sales, business development or equivalent experience
* 7\+ years of hands\-on work managing complex technology projects experience

**POSITION SUMMARY**


The Membership Sales Representative is responsible for fostering a culture of belonging, health, and connection across YMCA membership and wellness experiences. The Membership Sales Representative serves as a frontline ambassador for the YMCA — welcoming all, connecting members to programs and people, helping them pursue their wellness goals, and driving membership growth and retention.
