Inside Sales Representative – Pharmaceuticals \& Medical Supplies

We are looking for a **highly motivated, talented, and competitive Inside Sales Representative** who wants to build a substantial book of business and be rewarded directly for the results they produce.

This is not an order\-taking position. We are looking for someone who is **hungry to win, comfortable prospecting for new business, persistent in developing new accounts, and motivated by uncapped earning potential.**

Our company sells **pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to wholesale distributors and clinics specializing in clinical trials.** You will be responsible for developing your own customer base, building long\-term relationships, and turning those relationships into repeat business.

What You'll Do

You will take ownership of your territory and customer base from prospecting through ongoing account management.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Prospecting and developing new B2B accounts
* Identifying purchasing decision\-makers and developing relationships with them
* Selling pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to wholesale distributors and clinical\-trial\-focused clinics
* Learning customers' purchasing patterns, product needs, and supply challenges
* Following up consistently on quotes, opportunities, and potential orders
* Growing existing accounts through repeat business and additional product opportunities
* Maintaining strong, long\-term relationships with customers
* Managing your sales pipeline and staying organized with follow\-ups
* Working closely with our purchasing and operations teams to identify opportunities and fulfill customer needs

As you establish a strong customer base, the position becomes increasingly relationship\-driven, with more of your time focused on managing, retaining, and expanding the accounts you have developed.

Who We're Looking For

We want someone with **B2B inside sales experience** who understands that building a successful book of business takes consistent effort.

The right person is:

* Competitive and highly self\-motivated
* Comfortable proactively pursuing new business
* Persistent without being discouraged by rejection
* Naturally good at building business relationships
* An excellent communicator on the phone and through email
* Organized and disciplined with follow\-up
* Able to identify opportunities and move quickly
* Motivated by financial success
* Interested in building something over the long term rather than simply collecting a paycheck
* Able to work independently while also contributing to a team

Experience selling pharmaceuticals, medical supplies, healthcare products, or other B2B products is valuable, but **industry experience is not required if you have demonstrated B2B sales ability and are willing to learn.**

Compensation

This position is intentionally **commission\-heavy with a smaller base salary.**

We want our salespeople to have meaningful upside when they perform. Your earning potential will be driven largely by your ability to develop accounts, generate profitable sales, and grow your book of business.

**High performers will have the opportunity to earn substantially more than they would in a traditional salary\-heavy sales position.**

What Success Looks Like

In the beginning, success means **activity, persistence, and account development.** You should expect to spend significant time prospecting, contacting potential customers, and creating new relationships.

Over time, the goal is to **build a valuable book of repeat customers.**

We want our salespeople developing relationships that produce repeat orders, referrals, larger opportunities, and long\-term revenue.

As your customer base grows, your role will increasingly shift from pure prospecting toward **managing and expanding the relationships you've created.**

This Position Is a Great Fit If...

You are the type of salesperson who looks at a commission plan and thinks about the upside rather than the guarantee.

You enjoy competing.

You like developing relationships but aren't afraid to pursue new business.

You want your income to increase as your skills, customer base, and sales increase.

And most importantly, **you want an opportunity where exceptional performance is rewarded.**

If you're talented, hungry, persistent, and ready to build a serious book of business in the pharmaceutical and medical supply industry, we want to hear from you.

new_jobs.title: Key Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
==============



Concert Health is the leading national behavioral health medical group committed to integrating the Collaborative Care model into existing health care practices to improve patients' lives. We believe everyone, regardless of location or insurance, should have easy access to personalized, high\-quality behavioral health support that is guided by the provider they trust.


### **Who You Are**



You are a seasoned account leader who is energized by depth over breadth — you'd rather go deep on a smaller portfolio of complex, high\-value accounts than manage a wide book with less context on each. You build real fluency in each partner's clinical operations, stakeholders, and goals, and you use that fluency as the foundation for everything else: faster issue resolution, sharper growth strategy, and smoother provider onboarding.



You're equally comfortable being hands\-on and thinking several moves ahead. Day to day, you're the named point of contact partners trust to resolve issues and keep commitments on track. At the same time, you're building the data\-backed case for why a partner should expand, and running the onboarding plan for the next provider joining the account — moving between all three without losing sight of the relationship that ties them together.



You bring the judgment and track record of someone with 9\+ years in Account Management, Customer Success, or Client Services in healthcare, with a career trajectory into progressively larger and more complex accounts. You've driven measurable growth in existing accounts (not just retention), ideally onboarded new sites, providers, or users into a live account, and you're credible in a room with C\-suite and senior clinical leadership. Beyond your own accounts, other Account Managers look to you for how the job should be done — you set the standard, not just meet it.


### **Job Summary**



The Key Account Manager owns the complete lifecycle of Concert Health's most strategic partnerships — day\-to\-day relationship management, long\-term account growth, and the onboarding of new providers within existing accounts. This is Concert Health's most advanced individual\-contributor role in Account Management: one person, accountable end\-to\-end for a focused portfolio of high\-value, high\-complexity accounts, trusted to move fluidly between hands\-on servicing, strategic growth planning, and program\-managed provider launches without ever dropping the relationship thread.


**Core Responsibilities:**


*Own Day\-to\-Day Partner Success \& Issue Resolution:*


* Serve as the primary, named point of contact for a focused portfolio of key accounts, ensuring timely, high\-quality responses across clinical, operational, and administrative needs
* Proactively identify, triage, and resolve issues – driving toward systematic, scalable solutions rather than one\-off fixes
* Coordinate cross\-functional resources (clinical, operations, product, billing) to remove barriers and maintain momentum within each account
* Establish clear accountability, follow\-through, and communication loops so nothing falls through the cracks for your accounts
* Maintain deep, current fluency in each key account's clinical operations, stakeholders, and performance, so day\-to\-day servicing and long\-term strategy are always working from the same picture


*Grow Key Accounts*


* Own overall account performance for your portfolio – clinical, operational, and financial – with direct accountability for growth, not just retention
* Use utilization, outcomes, and financial data to identify white\-space opportunities within each key account and translate them into a concrete growth plan
* Build and pitch data\-backed growth and expansion cases to partner leadership, framing clinical outcomes and financial performance into a compelling case for investment
* Translate partner goals into actionable success plans with clear milestones and measurable outcomes, and hold both internal teams and partners accountable to them
* Lead negotiations with partner stakeholders to convert growth opportunities into signed, executed expansion


*Manage Leadership \& Executive Relationships*


* Build and maintain strong, trust\-based relationships with executive sponsors and senior clinical stakeholders at each key account
* Lead regular business reviews, presenting performance insights, outcomes, and growth recommendations
* Confidently navigate complex, matrixed stakeholder environments, aligning priorities and driving decision\-making
* Act as a strategic advisor, influencing partner leadership to invest in and expand Collaborative Care as a core model across their organization


*Set the Standard for the Function*


* Serve as a thought partner and mentor across the Account Management team, setting the bar for how account growth and provider onboarding should be done
* Define and codify the playbooks, frameworks, and best practices that other Account Managers are trained on
* Represent the voice of key accounts in product and clinical program roadmap discussions, with the credibility to shape how those roadmaps are prioritized
* Operate with a high degree of autonomy, ownership, and urgency – anticipating challenges before they arise and acting decisively to keep accounts on track


**Qualifications:**


* 9\+ years of experience in Account Management, Customer Success, or Client Services, with a demonstrated trajectory into progressively larger and more complex accounts
* Healthcare experience required
* Demonstrated success balancing hands\-on day\-to\-day account servicing with longer\-term strategic growth planning
* Proven track record driving measurable expansion or growth revenue within existing accounts, not just retention
* Experience onboarding or implementing new sites, providers, or users within an existing customer account preferred
* Strong foundational understanding of the healthcare delivery system in primary care and administrative/

new_jobs.description:
**Role Purpose**


This role sits within the Edge Product area of Accenture Global IT, acting as the primary account management and product liaison between Dell and the wider Accenture organization. The role manages the day\-to\-day Dell relationship, represents Accenture's interests in product and roadmap discussions, and ensures alignment between Dell's offerings and Accenture's internal edge, data center, and infrastructure modernization priorities.

**Key Relationships**

* Global IT Edge Compute
* Global IT IMS Leadership
* Global IT Strategy, Architecture and Innovation
* Accenture Dell Account Management Team

**Key Responsibilities**

**Dell Account \& Relationship Management**

* Own and manage the day\-to\-day relationship with Dell account contacts, acting as the primary point of contact for account\-level matters.
* Coordinate commercial discussions, including hardware pricing, licensing tiers, and contract matters, escalating decisions appropriately.
* Track and follow up on outstanding commercial items (e.g. hardware pricing, licensing tier decisions) and ensure resolution within agreed timelines.
* Support business review cycles and executive\-level engagements with Dell stakeholders.

**Internal Accenture Liaison**

* Act as the internal conduit between Dell and relevant Accenture stakeholders across Global IT, infrastructure, and edge teams.
* Support cross\-functional coordination on active workstreams, ensuring Dell\-related dependencies are tracked and communicated.
* Prepare and maintain materials (briefings, status updates) that keep internal stakeholders aligned on Dell\-related decisions and timelines.
* Flag unresolved decisions and dependencies proactively rather than allowing them to surface unaddressed to senior stakeholders.

**Product Roadmap Input \& Liaison**

* Gather and relay Dell product roadmap information relevant to Accenture's edge and infrastructure strategy.
* Provide structured input from Accenture's perspective into Dell's product planning where relationship and process allow.
* Support development of outcomes\-led, exec\-ready materials on edge infrastructure topics, translating technical detail appropriately for the audience.


Remote with with air travel associated with role 5 times a year (e.g. Conference, meetings)


  

**Here's What You Will Need**

* Minimum 5\+ years of experience in account management, partner/vendor management, or a similar relationship\-facing role, ideally with a major hardware/infrastructure vendor (e.g. Dell).
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience managing or coordinating complex, multi\-stakeholder commercial engagements, including contract governance or procurement processes.
* Minimum 3\+ years of experience with data center, edge computing, or hyperconverged infrastructure (HCI) concepts.
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate's Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience.)

**Preferred Experience**

* Prior experience working within or alongside a major enterprise IT function or shared services environment.
* Familiarity with Nutanix, VMware, or similar HCI platforms, even at a conceptual level.
* Exposure to AI infrastructure, GPU compute platforms, or edge compute deployments.
* Experience supporting or contributing to vendor business reviews, RFPs, or contract renewals.
* Knowledge of IT governance frameworks or compliance processes within large enterprises.

**Professional Skills**

* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to operate across both commercial and technical conversations.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and tracking multiple open items to resolution.
* Ability to synthesise technical and commercial information into clear, concise updates for senior leadership.
* Self\-directed with strong organisational discipline; capable of managing competing priorities across a distributed team and vendor landscape.
* Collaborative working style with the ability to build trusted relationships both internally and externally.

new_jobs.title: Technical Account Manager, AWS Enterprise Support, Strategic Industries
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  

  

Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers of all industries and sizes including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Big Data, and more gain the best value and service from AWS? At AWS Enterprise Support we’re looking for a Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support our customers’ creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technologies, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, Application\-level services, Networking, Serverless and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and ‘voice of the customer’ to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises.  

The TAM role is not directly hands on keyboard within the customer’s environment for troubleshooting customer support issues, rather you will work with appropriate engineers and service teams to see issues through to resolution. More importantly you will work proactively to help craft and execute strategies to drive our customers' adoption and use of AWS services, including EC2, S3, DynamoDB \& RDS databases, Lambda, CloudFront CDN, IoT, and many more.  

Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS within a customer’s environment, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding incidents, trade\-offs, support and risk management.  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to help plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep your customers’ AWS environments operationally healthy and resilient. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.
  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

  

  

About the team  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

  

Inclusive Team Culture  

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee\-led and company\-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.  

  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of technical engineering experience
* Experience with operational parameters and troubleshooting for three (3\) of the following: compute/storage/networking/CDN/databases/DevOps/big data and analytics/security/applications development in a distributed systems environment
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager, API
new_jobs.description:
Perplexity's API Platform brings our work in AI, search, and agent orchestration to developers. Our customers range from AI\-native startups to some of the world's largest technology companies. Working with them, alongside our own developments in building Perplexity’s core application gives our team direct exposure to how search, models, and tools are used to build and scale AI\-native products and applications.


**About this role**
-------------------


We are looking for a technically fluent Customer Success Manager to help our API customers succeed and shape how we support them as the business grows. You will own a portfolio of customers, understand what they are building, and help them move from evaluation to production and broader adoption.


Alongside your accounts, you will lead projects such as product and endpoint migrations, customer enablement, and communications for product updates and incidents. You will work directly with customers developing AI products and with the engineers building the APIs they depend on. As an early member of the team, you will help shape our customer success programs and bring what you learn from customers into product decisions.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------


* Own customer relationships across onboarding, adoption, retention, and expansion, building trust with developers, technical leaders, and business stakeholders.
* Understand each customer's use case, integration, and success criteria. Help them evaluate the APIs, resolve adoption barriers, and establish a path to production.
* Use account and product usage data to identify declining adoption, technical risks, and growth opportunities, then work with customers on specific next steps.
* Investigate technical questions using API documentation, sample requests, and usage data. Coordinate with Engineering and Support on deeper issues and keep customers informed through resolution.
* Lead customer\-facing programs such as endpoint migrations, product rollouts, and enablement. Define milestones, coordinate internal owners, and track customer readiness and completion.
* Manage customer communications for product changes, deprecations, and outages, partnering with technical teams to provide accurate updates and clear guidance.
* Build and improve the API customer success playbook, including onboarding, account reviews, customer health signals, escalation paths, and sales\-to\-CS handoffs.
* Partner with Sales and account owners on renewals and expansion, using adoption, consumption, and business outcomes to demonstrate value and surface risks early.
* Bring customer feedback into product planning and work with Developer Relations and Support on documentation and enablement that address recurring needs.

**What we're looking for**
--------------------------


* 4\+ years of experience in customer success, technical account management, solutions engineering, or a related customer\-facing role at a technology company.
* Technical fluency: comfortable reading API documentation, making API requests, interpreting responses and errors, and discussing integration questions with developers.
* A track record of driving adoption, retention, or growth across a portfolio of customers, with clear ownership of follow\-through.
* Experience creating or improving a customer program, playbook, or cross\-functional process, not only operating an established one.
* Strong written and verbal communication, including the ability to explain technical issues clearly and communicate carefully when facts are still developing.
* Sound judgment in balancing account needs with strategic projects, setting priorities, and moving work forward without a detailed brief.

**Nice to have**
----------------


* Experience with APIs, developer tools, cloud infrastructure, or usage\-based products.
* Familiarity with AI applications, search, retrieval, or agents, including how customers evaluate quality, latency, and cost.
* Working knowledge of Python or SQL for reproducing issues, analyzing usage, or automating recurring work.

new_jobs.title: Revenue Operations Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About Us**



AfterShip, a Great Place to Work Certified company, is transforming the global eCommerce landscape. Founded in 2012, AfterShip is a post\-purchase SaaS company on a mission to build the world's leading automation platform for ecommerce merchants.



AfterShip unifies shipping \& labels, order tracking, AI predictive delivery, and returns management into one system—giving merchants a single place to manage and automate everything that happens after checkout. By centralizing these workflows, AfterShip enables merchants to reduce customer support inquiries, deliver a more reliable and engaging customer experiences, and unlock incremental revenue at every post\-purchase touchpoint.



AfterShip integrates seamlessly with eCommerce platforms including Shopify and TikTok Shop, and connects with more than 1,400\+ carriers worldwide. Today, over 20,000 businesses—including Samsung, Gymshark, Mejuri, Dr. Squatch, and Alo Yoga—rely on AfterShip to turn every post\-purchase moment into an opportunity to build trust, reduce costs, and drive repeat purchases.



Built for a global market from day one, AfterShip operates with an engineering\-driven, internationally distributed team. The company employs more than 450 people across 8 offices, spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, and representing over 20 cities worldwide.


**Your Mission:**



As Revenue Operations Manager you will own the operational backbone that keeps our Sales, Customer Success, and Partnerships teams forecasting accurately, moving fast, and working out of clean systems. Reporting to the Senior Manager, Revenue Operations, you will partner across Sales, CS, Partnerships, Finance, and Legal to drive forecast accuracy, sales ops analysis, and cross\-functional projects to completion.



This role is built for someone who takes ownership of recurring cadences without being asked twice, drives tickets and initiatives to resolution rather than letting them stall, and balances hands\-on systems configuration with higher\-leverage analysis and process improvement. You'll be the person GTM leadership trusts to keep the forecast honest, the CRM clean, and cross\-functional projects actually shipping.


**What You'll Do:**


* Own the recurring sales and renewals forecast cadence end\-to\-end — scheduling, data accuracy across HubSpot, Gong Forecast/Engage, Tableau, and Control Center, publishing recaps and action items, and following up with owners until items close.
* Partner with Finance and CS leadership to reconcile renewal base, ARR, and attainment calculations.
* Analyze pipeline, routing, and attribution data to recommend and implement improvements (lead routing logic, ICP scoring, segmentation, meeting\-source attribution), proactively flagging data quality issues and process gaps along the way.
* Support quota setting, attainment tracking, and territory/account assignment logic.
* Drive cross\-functional initiatives — tooling rollouts, process changes, GTM system integrations — to completion with clear owners and deadlines, tracked visibly in Jira with blockers escalated early.
* Administer and own the sales tech stack (HubSpot, Gong, Chili Piper, Apollo, Lusha, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) — troubleshooting deal creation, routing, and data sync issues, plus licensing, vendor renewals, and budget consolidation.
* Support quoting, contract term negotiation, and vendor/partner agreement review with Legal and Deal Desk, and support Strategic and Platform Partnerships with attribution tracking, deal registration, and reporting.
* Own or directly support QBR/MBR prep for Sales and CS leadership, and support variable compensation calculations in partnership with RevOps Comp.


**Who We're Looking For:**


* 3\+ years in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or GTM Systems, ideally supporting both Sales and Customer Success.
* Hands\-on experience administering HubSpot and sales engagement/forecasting tools (Gong, Salesloft, Outreach, or similar), including owning a forecasting or pipeline reporting cadence end\-to\-end.
* Strong project management skills — a track record of driving cross\-functional work to completion, comfortable escalating blockers, with experience in Jira or a comparable ticketing system and a habit of proactive status updates.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — comfortable working directly with Sales, CS, Finance, Legal, and Partnerships stakeholders, and able to run and summarize cross\-functional meetings.
* Familiarity with variable compensation or deal desk processes; experience supporting a Partnerships or Channel function.


*At AfterShip, we know great talent doesn't always fit every requirement. If you're passionate about our mission and believe you can make an impact, we encourage you to apply.*

  


**Why You Should Join Us:**


* **Great Place to Work Certified:** We've been recognized for our inclusive, values\-driven culture that celebrates diversity and collaboration.
* **Innovative \& Inclusive Culture:** Started by our software engineer\-turned\-CEO, AfterShip is built on curiosity, creativity, and collaboration. We're a passionate, global team of problem solvers who put egos aside to innovate together. We take immense pride in fostering a culture that's inclusive, which has allowed us to surround ourselves with the industry's most talented professionals.
* **Ambitious Mission with Real Impact:** Join us in transforming eCommerce by making buying and selling easier for everyone. It's one of the most dynamic spaces in tech, with limitless opportunities to innovate and grow.
* **Thrive \& Grow:** There's no ceiling to what you can achieve or learn here. We're committed to empowering your career while advancing together as a company.
* **Flexible Work Setup**: We're a remote\-first team, meaning by default that employees work from home or on a hybrid\-flexible basis in our hub locations. You're empowered to choose a work setup that works best for you and your team. With flex

new_jobs.title: Technical Customer Success Manager
new_jobs.description:
**About us**
------------


MintMCP helps companies put agents to work safely. We exist to help companies do more of their work with agents, and we build the infrastructure that makes a company's own work runnable by them. Our product gives those agents governed access to company data and tools. That has to start from trust.

  

Before agents can touch Slack, GitHub, Jira, Snowflake, internal databases, or production systems, you need to know what they can reach, what they did, and why they were allowed to do it. Most people carry far more permissions than any single task needs. If an agent uses your token directly, it inherits all of them. MintMCP scopes that access down to exactly what an agent needs to do its job and captures the data flows and audit logs security teams need. From there we are building the rest of the agent stack: connectors, monitoring, sandboxing, long\-running agents, and memory, with the goal of becoming the system a company's work runs on.

  

We work in person in the San Francisco Bay Area. The structure is flat and the market moves fast, so you have a lot of latitude over what you work on and how.

  

We are AI\-native. Everyone uses Claude and Codex every day, and we have more agents than employees. They run in Slack alongside the team and handle sales, marketing, deal ops, and engineering on the same gateway we sell to customers, and we are building an entire company operating system around them.

  

Since launching in February 2026, we have grown to 50\+ paying customers, with strong inbound demand. Customers include Coursera, Arlo, and Braze. We are backed by Cowboy Ventures and Coatue, with angels including Frederic Kerrest (Okta), Michael Grinich (WorkOS), Andrej Karpathy, Jeff Dean, and Scott Belsky. Our founders are machine learning experts from Stanford, Berkeley, and CMU, with applied research at Google Brain and Waymo, and one co\-founded Coursera.

  

**The job**
-----------


You own the customer once the deal is signed, all the way through. On day one that means building the mutual delivery plan with the customer: what success looks like, who does what, and by when. You drive onboarding, get the product live against real use cases, and stay close as usage grows. You are the person the customer trusts to make their rollout work.

  

From there you own the whole arc. You track account health, run the check\-ins and business reviews, catch problems before they become risks, and pull in engineering or the founders when a customer needs more than you can give them alone. You own renewals, and you find and grow expansion, more teams, more agents, more of the company's work running on us. When something is on fire, you are the one who owns getting it resolved.

  

You'll also push in both directions. On the customer side, that means telling them when what they've asked for isn't what they need, and reframing it against what we've seen work elsewhere. Internally, it means advocating for your customers clearly and directly to the founders — while weighing what they want against what the company needs to prioritize. We'd rather you argue with us than quietly agree with a customer.

  

You are our first dedicated post\-sales hire, so you also build the function. You turn what works into a repeatable motion: the delivery plan template, health scoring, the review rhythm, the handoff from sales. As the customer base grows, you help decide who we hire next and grow into leading customer success. The role is in person, with travel to meet customers.

  

**About you**
-------------

* You are exceptional with customers. People trust you quickly, and you keep a rollout on track without being told to. This is the core of the job.
* You have owned customer relationships end to end, in customer success, account management, consulting, or a client\-delivery role.
* You can run a plan and drive it to an outcome across a customer's team, aligning stakeholders, tracking commitments, and keeping momentum.
* You are comfortable in technical conversations without being an engineer. You can hold your own with a technical buyer, explain what the product does and why it matters, and know when to pull in the team for the deep end. You do not write config or debug integrations.
* You have carried retention and expansion, or have the commercial instinct to, and can point to relationships you kept and grew.
* You have built structure where there was none, playbooks, templates, cadences, and you would rather build the motion than inherit one.
* You are calm under pressure and own the outcome when a customer is unhappy.
* You are AI\-native, or will get there fast, and are genuinely curious about AI, agents, and how companies adopt them.
* You move fast without a lot of process, and you want to grow into leading a team.

  

**Bonus**
---------

* AI solutions engineer or forward\-deployed engineer background.
* You've sold to or supported technical and engineering buyers.
* Experience with enterprise rollouts where security review, procurement, and multi\-threading are part of the relationship.
* Comfort representing the company in person: business reviews, dinners, and on\-site meetings with technical and security leaders.

  

**What we offer**
-----------------

* Competitive base, variable, and significant equity.
* Full ownership of your accounts, with room to build the function and grow into leadership.
* Direct access to the CEO, customers, and product decisions.
* Health benefits, on a team that puts family and health first.

 *Prefer to have your agent apply? Point it at* *https://www.mintmcp.com/hiring/mcp*

* Knowledge and experience with online merchandising best practices and e\-commerce metrics.

-----------------


Whether you're on a consumer product (like Gmail, Search, Maps, Chrome, Android) or a business product (Google Ads, AdSense, Google Marketing Platform, Analytics), you take part in a complete marketing experience as you lead every facet of the product's journey. Learn more about benefits at Google.**Responsibilities**

**About NYRR**


New York Road Runners (NYRR) was founded in 1958 when a small group of passionate runners vowed to bring running to the people and has grown from a local running club into the world’s premier community running organization. NYRR’s vision is to build healthier lives and stronger communities through the transformative power of running.  



NYRR’s year\-round offerings of races, community events, programs, and training resources provide hundreds of thousands of people with the motivation, know\-how, and opportunities to start running and keep running for life. NYRR’s premier event, the famed TCS New York City Marathon, attracts the world’s top professional runners and committed amateurs alike, while also raising millions of dollars annually for charity and driving economic impact for New York City. NYRR is equally committed to the runners of tomorrow, passionately providing youth fitness programs that educate and inspire children in underserved communities in New York City, nationwide, and around the world.

  



Headquartered in New York City, NYRR is a 501(c)(3\) organization. To learn more, please visit **www.nyrr.org**.  

*At New York Road Runners, we are committed to building an inclusive, diverse workplace by finding the best candidate for the job. We understand that skills come from a variety of different backgrounds. Checking off every single requirement on our job description is not necessary to apply. If you think you are a good fit and have a passion for the work we do, please submit your application. We are eager to learn about your experience and skills! You may be the right candidate for this or other open positions.*

  



*New York Road Runners is an Equal Opportunity Employer*

 **About the Department**


The Strategic Partnerships \& Runner Products Department includes the Business Development and Strategic Partnerships team, the Runner Products and Services team, The Strategic Partnerships \& Runner Products Department includes the Business Development and Strategic Partnerships team, the Runner Products and Services team, and the Professional Athlete Group.

  

The Business Development and Strategic Partnerships team secures and manages mission\-aligned partnerships providing revenue, value\-in\-kind and strategic support for advancing NYRR's mission. The team collaborates across NYRR departments to maximize partnership value and runner engagement through strategic programming. Additionally, the department oversees licensing of NYRR IP rights, including production of co\-branded product and apparel.

  

The Runner Products and Services team enhances the training, racing, and community experience through in\-person runner training, tailored customer service, and community engagement at the NYRR *RUN*CENTER. NYRR’s Official Charity Partner Program includes more than 600 official charity partners raising over $80 million annually, while the International Tour Operator (ITO) Program spans 100\+ countries and brings more than 13,000 international runners to the TCS New York City Marathon each year.

  

The Professional Athlete Group develops and manages programs for professional and sub\-elite runners, including wheelchair athletes, working closely with athletes, agents, coaches, and federations, and leading recruitment strategies for elite participation in NYRR events.

 **About the Position**


The Charity Program Coordinator will support the Charity Program Team in managing relationships with Official Charity Partners and planning and executing Charity Partner activations surrounding premier New York Road Runners events, including the TCS New York City Marathon and United Airlines NYC Half.

 **Job Responsibilities***(primary and secondary duties)***:**

* Support contracting and invoicing of Charity Partners, including creating, sending, tracking, and updating Sales Force database
* Support account set\-up and maintenance in NYRR registration system
* Assist with planning and provide event support at special events surrounding the TCS New York City Marathon
* Provide customer service support to charity partners and runners through email, phone, and in\-person at events
* Support development of program materials such as user guides and newsletters
* Provide general program support as needed

 **Job Requirements:**


*Experience:*

* 1\+ years of relevant work experience
* Experience working at or with non\-profits a plus

 *Skills and Attributes:*

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Power Point, Outlook)
* Strong attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Experience with Salesforce and/or NetSuite preferred
* Ability to interact in a professional and friendly way with diverse groups
* Ability to work occasional weekends or evenings
* Strong commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion

 *Other Requirements:*

* All staff are required to work the United Airlines NYC Half Marathon, RBC Brooklyn Half Marathon, and the TCS NYC Marathon.
* Operate on a hybrid schedule, with two days per week in the NYRR office in NYC

---------------


AWS is seeking a world class sales professional to manage and grow our global business relationship with one of the largest entertainment and technology companies in the world.

The Global Account Manager (GAM) is responsible for teaming with the customer’s Line\-of\-Business (LOB) and IT Organizations to build strategic relationships across the account. new_jobs.title: Business Development Representative, Healthcare (C1 - B2B)
new_jobs.description:
CLEAR is building THE secure identity company of the future. Our mission is to make experiences safer and easier—physically and digitally. With more than 43 million Members and a growing network of partners across the world, CLEAR's secure identity platform is transforming the way people live, work, and travel. Whether it's at the airport, stadium, or throughout your everyday life, CLEAR unlocks the magic of frictionless experiences.


We're looking for a Business Development Representative to help grow CLEAR's Healthcare business by building pipeline and creating qualified opportunities with healthcare organizations and prospective partners. You'll combine thoughtful prospecting, compelling storytelling, and curiosity about our customers to introduce healthcare leaders to CLEAR's identity solutions and help make healthcare experiences safer and easier.

  


***What you'll do:***


* Own pipeline generation across inbound and outbound channels, consistently creating high\-quality opportunities for CLEAR's Healthcare business
* Prospect and engage healthcare decision\-makers through strategic, personalized outreach across email, phone, social selling, and other channels
* Understand prospective customers, their needs, their challenges, and the healthcare landscape to clearly articulate how CLEAR's identity solutions can create value
* Partner closely with Sales and Account Executives to qualify prospects, uncover opportunities, and build pipeline that converts into revenue
* Collaborate with Marketing, Sales, and Product to sharpen messaging and go\-to\-market strategies, using data and insights to continuously improve outreach, conversion, and efficiency

  


***How you'll measure success:***


* Qualified healthcare pipeline generated and influenced against quarterly targets
* Achievement of outbound activity, response, meeting conversion, and opportunity generation targets
* Revenue contribution from sourced opportunities, including pipeline quality, velocity, and conversion to closed\-won business
* Demonstrated expertise in CLEAR's identity solutions, target customers, and the healthcare landscape

  


***What you're great at:***


* 2\+ years of experience in sales or business development, or a related customer\-facing role
* Building relationships through excellent written, verbal, and listening skills, with the ability to understand customer needs and communicate a compelling value proposition
* Taking ownership of your goals with a self\-starter mindset, persistence, curiosity, and a bias for action in a fast\-paced, evolving environment
* Using data and a process\-oriented approach to understand performance, identify opportunities, and continuously improve prospecting and outbound strategies
* Leveraging sales technologies such as Salesforce, Outreach, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator to research prospects, personalize outreach, and build pipeline effectively
* Embracing AI and emerging technologies thoughtfully to strengthen prospect research, personalize outreach, identify opportunities, and improve productivity while maintaining a high bar for quality and judgment

  


***How You'll be Rewarded:***



At CLEAR, we help YOU move forward \- because when you're at your best, we're at our best. You'll work with talented team members motivated by our mission of making experiences safer and easier. Our offices are bright and energetic with an open concept and plenty of conference rooms and casual co\-working spaces. We also offer catered lunches every day and have fully stocked kitchens. Outside of the office, we invest in your well\-being and learning \& development with stipends and reimbursement programs.



We offer holistic total rewards, including comprehensive healthcare plans, family\-building benefits (fertility and adoption/surrogacy support), flexible time off, annual wellness stipend, free OneMedical memberships for you and your dependents, a CLEAR Plus membership, and a 401(k) retirement plan with employer match. The on\-target compensation range for this role is $70,000 \- $120,000, depending on levels of skills and experience.



The on target earning range represents the low and high end of CLEAR's range for this position. OTE will vary depending on various factors which include, but are not limited to location, education, skills, experience and performance. The range listed is just one component of CLEAR's total compensation package for employees and other rewards may include annual bonuses, commission, Restricted Stock Units.


*Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, protected veteran status or other characteristics protected by law.*

Please let us know if you require a reasonable accommodation to apply for a job or perform your job. *We are committed to a transparent and secure hiring process. All communications related to this role will come directly from a CLEAR employee through valid CLEAR channels (e.g., a valid @clearme.com email address or verified CLEAR LinkedIn profile). new_jobs.title: Sales Development Representative
new_jobs.description:
**About the Role**
Club Athletic is a community\-first fitness brand built on the Training Squad: people who train together, twice a week, at a set time, with a dedicated coach. Every month a large number of people create an account with us but never take the next step — they don't book a call, attend a class, or join a squad. This role exists to change that. As our Sales Development Representative, you own that overlooked pool of leads. Through the week you reach out to people who signed up but went quiet and get them booked onto a call. On weekends you run those calls yourself and close them into memberships. It's a role for someone who loves both the chase and the close — persistent on outreach, warm on the phone, motivated by clear targets and real commission.


**What Success Looks Like**
Targets are set and reviewed with the Sales Manager. Not all are tied to commission, but all measure success in the role.


Primary Metrics

* Calls Booked — Number of placement / sales calls booked from the unactioned\-lead pool each month.
* Show Rate — Lifting the share of booked calls that actually attend (the current show rate has room to grow).
* Memberships Closed — New Training Squad memberships you personally close each month.
* Speed\-to\-Lead (SLA) — Meet the response SLA — every lead contacted within 90 minutes during operating hours, and first thing at 8am for leads that come in after 7pm.

About Box Beauty

Box Beauty is a fast\-growing B2B wholesale platform focused on trending collectibles, blind boxes, licensed character merchandise, designer toys, plush, gifts, and lifestyle products.

We work with independent retailers, specialty stores, gift shops, beauty supply stores, toy and collectible stores, Asian supermarkets, convenience retailers, mall stores, and other local businesses looking for new and differentiated products.

We are expanding our local wholesale presence in the Atlanta market and are looking for a hands\-on Field Sales Representative who enjoys getting out into the market, meeting store owners, building relationships, and turning product interest into repeat business.

This is not a desk\-only sales role.

You will spend a significant amount of your time visiting local retailers, introducing products, following up with existing accounts, helping customers place orders, and developing long\-term wholesale relationships.

\#\# The Opportunity

Box Beauty already has an established local operating partner in Atlanta, including access to warehouse capabilities and an existing network of retail customers.

The Atlanta market has shown demand for our product categories, but many local retailers still prefer face\-to\-face service, local product availability, and direct support instead of purchasing entirely online.

Your job will be to help turn that opportunity into a strong local wholesale business.

You will initially focus on:

\* Following up with an existing pool of local retail customers

\* Visiting stores and developing relationships with owners and buyers

\* Introducing new products and best\-selling items

\* Helping retailers place first orders and reorders

\* Expanding Box Beauty's customer base throughout Metro Atlanta

\* Learning which products, categories, and price points perform best locally

Over time, this role may become a key part of a larger Atlanta wholesale operation, including a potential local showroom / warehouse store.

\#\# What You Will Do

\#\#\# Existing Account Development

A major part of this position will be working with existing retail relationships and warm customer leads.

You will:

\* Contact and visit existing retail accounts

\* Reintroduce inactive customers

\* Understand what each store currently sells

\* Identify products that fit each customer's business

\* Present new arrivals and in\-stock merchandise

\* Follow up after initial conversations

\* Help customers place wholesale orders

\* Encourage reorders based on previous purchases and product performance

\* Maintain ongoing relationships with store owners and buyers

This role is not just about opening accounts.

We care strongly about whether customers reorder and become long\-term BoxBeautycustomers.

\#\#\# Local Field Sales

You will regularly visit retailers throughout the Atlanta area.

Typical target customers may include:

\* Toy and collectible stores

\* Gift shops

\* Anime and pop\-culture stores

\* Beauty supply stores

\* Asian supermarkets

\* Lifestyle retailers

\* Independent convenience stores

\* Specialty retailers

\* Mall stores and kiosks

\* Independent neighborhood retailers

You should be comfortable walking into stores, introducing yourself, speaking directly with owners or buyers, and developing new relationships from the ground up.

\#\#\# Product Presentation

You will learn Box Beauty's product assortment and help retailers understand which products may fit their stores.

This includes:

\* Blind boxes

\* Designer toys

\* Character merchandise

\* Plush

\* Keychains

\* Collectibles

\* Gifts

\* Lifestyle products

\* Trend\-driven merchandise

You do not need to be an expert in every product category on day one.

However, you should be curious about products, retail trends, and what makes merchandise sell in different types of stores.

\#\#\# Sales Follow\-Up

Many wholesale sales are not closed during the first conversation.

You will be responsible for consistent follow\-up, including:

\* Phone calls

\* Text messages

\* Email

\* In\-person visits

\* Product updates

\* New arrival notifications

\* Reorder reminders

We are looking for someone who is organized and persistent without being overly aggressive.

\#\#\# New Account Development

In addition to working with existing relationships, you will identify and develop new retailers throughout the Atlanta market.

You may:

\* Visit retail districts and shopping centers

\* Identify potential wholesale customers

\* Build local prospect lists

\* Ask for referrals from existing customers

\* Develop relationships with store owners and local retail groups

\* Introduce Box Beauty to businesses that do not currently buy from us

\#\#\# Market Feedback

Because this is a developing market for Box Beauty, your feedback will be extremely valuable.

You will help us understand:

\* Which products customers respond to

\* Which products do not perform well

\* Which retail segments have the strongest demand

\* Common objections from buyers

\* Competitive products and pricing

\* Customer preferences

\* Demand for local pickup

\* Demand for same\-day or local warehouse fulfillment

\* Opportunities for new product categories

We expect our first Atlanta Field Sales Representative to help us build not only sales, but also a better understanding of the Atlanta wholesale market.

\#\# What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is not measured only by how many stores you visit.

We will look at several areas, including:

\* Number of qualified retailer conversations

\* Number of store visits

\* New accounts activated

\* Sales generated

\* Repeat orders

\* Reorder rate

\* Active customer growth

\* Customer retention

\* Quality of customer relationships

\* Local market coverage

As the territory develops, monthly sales goals will become an increasingly important part of the role.

Our goal is to build a repeatable, profitable Atlanta wholesale business

new_jobs.title: Executive & Personal Operations Assistant
new_jobs.description:
Executive \& Personal Operations Assistant

**Part\-Time \| Hybrid \| Naperville, Illinois**  
**Approximately 15–20 hours/week \| $25–$35/hour**

I’m an entrepreneur and founder looking for an exceptional person who genuinely **loves getting things done**.

This is not a traditional corporate Executive Assistant position. I’m looking for someone who gets real satisfaction from taking a long list of tasks, bringing order to it, figuring things out, and making things disappear from my plate.

I have a lot of ideas, projects and moving pieces. I’m looking for the person who loves the other side of that equation: **organizing, completing, following up and closing loops.**

A significant part of this position involves **computer and backend administrative work**, so you should genuinely enjoy working on a computer, learning new tools and solving little technology problems.

You don't need to know how to do everything already. You do need to be the kind of person who thinks:

**“I don't know how to do that yet, but I'll figure it out.”**

Some of your work can be done independently from home. I also want someone who lives close enough to **Naperville to work alongside me in person approximately 1–2 times a week** when needed.

What you might help me with

* Organizing Google Drive, documents and folders so things are actually easy to find
* Managing spreadsheets, lists and trackers
* Keeping projects and outstanding tasks organized
* Updating databases and contact lists
* Scheduling appointments and coordinating calendars
* Completing online forms and applications
* Uploading, downloading and organizing documents and materials
* Formatting documents and presentations
* Researching information online and summarizing what you find
* Following up with people and keeping track of open items
* Preparing materials for meetings
* Printing, scanning and organizing paperwork
* Helping coordinate travel, reservations and logistics
* Using ChatGPT and other AI tools to work faster and smarter
* Basic Canva or similar tools
* Helping with occasional personal administrative tasks
* Troubleshooting the random technology and administrative problems that inevitably come up
* Noticing something that needs to be done—and taking care of it before I have to ask

You may love this role if...

You **love a checklist** and get satisfaction from checking the last box.

You are the person friends ask when they can't figure something out on their computer.

A messy Google Drive doesn't scare you—it makes you want to organize it.

You notice details other people miss.

You don't need someone constantly reminding you what needs to be done.

If I say, **“Can you figure this out for me?”** your instinct is to start researching rather than tell me why it can't be done.

You enjoy bringing order to lots of moving pieces.

You communicate clearly when something needs my decision, but you don't need my approval for every small decision.

You are warm, trustworthy, discreet and dependable.

You are comfortable learning new technology and using AI.

And most importantly, you genuinely enjoy **finishing things and closing loops**.

Experience as an executive assistant, personal assistant, administrative assistant, operations coordinator or project coordinator is wonderful, but I care just as much about **resourcefulness, judgment, technology skills, attitude and follow\-through** as I do about your résumé.

The details

This position will initially be approximately **15–20 hours per week**, with flexibility in how those hours are structured.

Some work can be remote, with approximately **1–2 in\-person working sessions per week in the Naperville area**.

Compensation is approximately **$25–$35/hour**, depending on experience and capabilities.

There may be an opportunity for the position and hours to grow over time if we are a great fit.

Final candidates may be invited to complete a **paid working interview** so we can both experience what it would actually be like to work together.

To apply

Please send:

* A brief introduction about yourself and **why this particular position caught your attention**.
* An example of something complicated, disorganized or unfamiliar that someone handed you and **you figured out**.
* The computer programs, technology and AI tools you feel most comfortable using.
* Your approximate weekly availability.
* Your desired hourly rate.
* A casual **60–90 second video introducing yourself**. Nothing polished—we simply want to meet you.

And please answer this question:

**Imagine you arrive Monday morning and I give you 25 unfinished tasks, a messy Google Drive, three things that need research, several people who need follow\-up, and two things that are urgent. What would you do first?**

We're ultimately looking for the person we can confidently say:

**“Give it to them. They'll figure it out.”**

Pay: $25\.00 \- $35\.00 per hour

Expected hours: 15\.0 – 20\.0 per week

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Naperville, IL 60563

new_jobs.title: Account Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Are you looking for limitless career opportunities with a company that values growth, innovation, and teamwork?** At Ntiva, we’re more than a Managed Services Provider, we’re a community dedicated to helping each other, our clients, and their businesses thrive both personally and professionally. Ntiva is a culture of people who are passionate about the work…and each other.



Our clients view us as an essential part of their teams, relying on us for strategic guidance, fast solutions to complex challenges, and proactive support. With strategic locations across the U.S. and leadership from our founder, Steven Freidkin, we’re on the front lines of a fast\-paced industry, facing cybersecurity threats and rapid technology changes together.



If you thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment and enjoy going above and beyond, we’d love to meet you. Come explore one of our many opportunities and grow with us!


**How you will make an impact**



As the Account Manager (AM), you own the client relationship. This is the highest leverage seat in Client Success. Clients trust you to understand their business, connect their technology to where it is going, and make sure Ntiva delivers. You are not a messenger between the client and internal teams. You are the decision bearer in the room. The role is focused on four outcomes: clients who stay because risk was caught early, revenue that grows through disciplined roadmap execution and clean agreements, an expansion pipeline you qualified yourself, and time reclaimed from reactive work and spent on strategy instead.

  


**Location and work expectations**


* Hybrid role in the Chicagoland area, approximately 80% remote and 20% client visits. Allocation may fluctuate based on business needs.
* Must be able to travel by car to client locations, with a valid driver’s license and an insured vehicle.
* Monday through Friday, approximately 8am to 5pm CST.

  


**What you will be doing**


**Own the relationship**


* Own a defined book of business, generally $2M to $2\.5M in annual recurring revenue across approximately 25 to 30 clients, sized by client tier mix and role level.
* Carry the relationship at the executive level. Show up prepared and on time, with an agenda and a written follow\-up summary, and hold the room.
* Run escalations behind the scenes rather than in front of the client, communicate in the language of the client’s business rather than the ticketing system, and maintain a living map of each client’s decision maker, economic buyer, champions, and blockers.


**Drive the strategy**


* Understand how each client makes money, and translate their business objectives into a 12 to 24 month technology roadmap.
* Lead the prescribed engagement cadence for your book of business, including Service Reviews, Strategic Cadences, Technology Business Reviews, and Annual Reviews, leading with the client’s business context rather than a report on Ntiva activity.
* Position new services as answers to a problem you have already diagnosed, and qualify expansion opportunities before engaging solution architect or professional services time.
* Identify at\-risk clients early using defined risk signals, and produce a written save plan before a contract conversation becomes necessary.


**Own the commercials**


* Read and reconcile a client invoice, and explain every line without escalating internally.
* Own renewals end to end: the right mix of services, a current agreement stack, migration off legacy SKUs, and statements of work precise enough that Onboarding can execute without chasing.
* Apply credit discipline as if the margin were your own, recognize when service recovery beats a credit, and use client profitability as an input to account strategy.
* Engage past due clients with clarity and speed, and own your part of accounts receivable tickets end to end with current notes.


**Partner internally**


* Know the services matrix and which team owns which work, including when to engage the solution architect, vCIO, IT Advisor, and Service Delivery, and when not to.
* Qualify work before engaging peer teams, hand off cleanly with confirmation of receipt and an explicit next step, respect peer team process rather than routing around it, and hold peer teams accountable respectfully through a defined path to a defined person.
* Bring client feedback back to Ntiva teams with the diagnostic work done and a solution proposed. Advocacy is not echo. Set client expectations early and hold the line, including saying no, and train clients on how to engage Ntiva.


**Manage your capacity**


* Manage your time so every client receives what they are entitled to, adhere to scheduled block time, and build the week around proactive work rather than inbox reaction.
* Delegate to the right team rather than carrying work by default, push clients toward self\-service where it serves them well, and use approved AI tooling and published documentation for summaries, follow\-up drafting, and routine reconciliation where appropriate.
* Work in ConnectWise Manage fluently across the AM workflow, keep ticket notes current so peer teams see movement without asking, and execute renewals, service additions, and decommissions per process.

  


**How success is defined in this role**


* **CORE values.** Care: outcomes over transactions, and a client who is struggling or unusually quiet is a signal to act on. Ownership: you are accountable from first engagement through renewal, including the fix that prevents a repeat. Responsiveness: you reply within a business day and update proactively. Empathy: you hear the concern before offering the solution.
* **Four behaviors.** Strategic Thinking: technology serves the client’s business goals, and you apply patterns across your portfolio. Proactive Engagement: you surface issues before they escalate and deliver value between formal touchpoints. Internal Advocacy: you represent client interests without damaging relationships with colleague

If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.


With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.


Remote within the United States with 40\-60% travel to customer sites and MSS facilities.

**Role Overview:**


Based in the US the Strategic Account Manager is directly accountable to our Semiconductor Metrology and Inspection Key accounts for Material Science solutions (MSS) in North America. You aren’t just a "point of contact"—you are a business partner responsible for aligning the customer’s project timelines to our operational capacity and bringing in new product introduction wins (NPI).


You will be finding, championing and winning opportunities our core technologies in optics, laser machining and mechatronics within these key customers. You will use key tools such as 80/20 and MEDDPICC to deliver accelerated growth to MSS.


This role will represent 14 MSS factories to our customers with special focus on: CVI Laser Optics, IDEX Health and Science Rochester, Louwers Hanique and Millux.

**Key Responsibilities:**


Opportunity Identification \& Growth

* Execute our strategic intent through to 2030\. Understand the ways and means we will grow our platform and leverage them within your customers to build new opportunities.
* Pipeline Development: Identify within our key accounts the urgent and immediate pain which MSS can solve. Align MSS and customer business roadmaps. Turn these activities into business opportunities
* Strategic Upselling: Drive "share of wallet" growth by introducing existing customers to new technologies, materials, or service offerings.
* Achieve year\-on\-year incremental share increases in alignment with goals and priorities set by Key Account director and Metrology and Inspection Sales director.


NPI \& Project Alignment

* Drive timely and accurate completion of MEDDPICC and 80/20 process for incoming requests and outgoing quotes
* Ideation to Production: Lead the "speed advantage" strategy, ensuring that new projects move through the design phase without operational bottlenecks.
* Align the customer’s need timeline with our production scheduling to ensure projects are delivered on time to launch.
* Requirement Alignment: Act as the voice of the customer to critical needs are fully incorporated into solution offering.


Forecasting \& Demand Planning

* Data Integrity: Build and maintain 12\-month rolling demand forecasts to drive raw material procurement and factory capacity planning.
* Risk Mitigation: Identify gaps between customer forecasts and actual PO placement, flagging potential under\-utilization or capacity "crunches" before they occur.


Internal Operational \& Customer Alignment

* Conduct regular face to face meetings with key customer stakeholders to review new business opportunities, business reviews, customer quality, scorecard feedback and to discover customer intelligence.
* Act as the main escalation path for customer concerns on factory performance.
* Constraint Management: Regularly sync with the Production, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to understand current floor capacity, equipment downtime, and material lead times.
* Constraint Synchronization: Partner with the Enterprise Solutions Engineering Team to ensure that customer quality constraints and delivery schedules are realistic and executable.

**Candidate Profile:**

* 5\+ years semiconductor OEM/account management experience
* Strong verbal and written communication skills
* High technical fluency in one or more of Semiconductor metrology inspection tools, optics, laser machine processing, high voltage feedthroughs or precision machining.
* Basic computer skills required, including facility with Microsoft Office and experience with custom CRM and ERP systems
* Ability to consistently represent the business in the best light in all circumstances.
* The "Hunter" Mentality: Proven ability to find and close new business opportunities within a technical or industrial landscape.
* Manufacturing IQ: Deep understanding of the production lifecycle, including lead times, supply chain constraints, and the NPI process.
* Analytical Rigor: Ability to synthesize complex data into accurate forecasts using ERP software and Advanced Excel functions.
* Communication Mastery: The ability to say "no" or "not yet" to a customer in a way that preserves the relationship while protecting the business’s operational integrity.

Generally, a "U.S. Person" is a U.S. citizen, U.S. national, lawful permanent resident, or an individual who has been granted refugee or asylum status.

**About Stutz Company:**

Stutz Company is a leading supplier of specialty chemicals and materials for the metal finishing and manufacturing industries. We're growing and looking for a driven Sales Representative to help us expand our reach.

**Objective:**  
Generate new business opportunities by identifying, prospecting, and engaging manufacturers that use specific industrial chemicals. This is a pure hunting role with no existing account responsibility.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Make **30–40 outbound calls per day** to targeted prospects.
* Build and maintain a pipeline of qualified opportunities.
* Research target accounts using **ZoomInfo, LinkedIn, AI tools, industry databases, and CRM systems**.
* Identify decision\-makers in purchasing, operations, engineering, quality, and plant management.
* Develop account\-specific outreach strategies.
* Schedule discovery calls and meetings for sales leadership.
* Maintain accurate CRM records and activity tracking.
* Continuously refine prospecting workflows using AI and automation tools.

**Ideal Candidate**

* 2–10 years of B2B sales, business development, or lead generation experience.
* Strong hunter mentality with a proven track record of cold outreach.
* Chemical industry experience preferred but not required.
* Strong business acumen and ability to understand manufacturing operations.
* Comfortable speaking with plant managers, engineers, buyers, and executives.
* Self\-motivated, competitive, and highly organized.

**Technical Requirements**

Must demonstrate proficiency with:

* CRM systems (HubSpot, Salesforce, etc.)
* ZoomInfo or similar prospecting platforms
* LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, etc.) for:
* Prospect research
* Account prioritization
* Email creation
* Call preparation
* Territory mapping

**Success Metrics**

* 30–40 outbound calls per day
* New target accounts identified weekly
* Qualified meetings generated
* Pipeline value created
* Revenue generated from new accounts

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: From $70,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Health insurance
* Paid time off

Application Question(s):

* Are you comfortable making 40 outbound sales calls per day?

* metal finishing: 1 year (Preferred)
